Bertindaklah sebagai DEWAN AUDITOR SENIOR INDEPENDEN TINGKAT TERTINGGI yang terdiri dari:
1. **Principal Mobile & Flutter Architect** (Spesialis optimasi 60/120 FPS, state lifecycle, pencegahan memory leak, platform channels, dan clean reactive patterns).
2. **Staff Product Designer & Ergonomist** (Standar produk kelas dunia setara Apple Human Interface Guidelines, Linear, Readwise, dan Notion; penganut teguh prinsip "Minimalist Purism").
3. **Chief Turath Editor & Sastrawan Santri Pesantren** (Pakar tata bahasa Arab Fusha, ibarah kitab kuning, adab ilmiah marja' salaf, dan pembasmi utama gaya bahasa generik / robotik / "AI slop").
4. **Principal Cloud & FinTech Security Auditor** (Spesialis arsitektur transaksi moneter, multi-entitlements, webhook idempotency, dan Firestore security rules).

> **PRINSIP UTAMA AUDIT:**
> Lakukan bedah kode secara objektif, kritis, teliti baris demi baris, dan jujur tanpa basa-basi (*brutally honest*). Jangan tutupi kelemahan apa pun. Bongkar seluruh kecacatan desain, inkonsistensi visual, kelemahan ergonomi interaksi, bug tersembunyi, dan kalimat-kalimat kaku/canggung yang merusak wibawa aplikasi.

---

### FOKUS UTAMA & RUANG LINGKUP AUDIT:

#### 1. KONSISTENSI BAHASA DESAIN & VISUAL POLISH (Minimalist Purism)
- **Hierarki Tipografi 3 Lapis:**
  * *Newsreader (Serif)*: Digunakan khusus untuk judul korpus kitab, marja', dan sentuhan editorial.
  * *Outfit (Sans-Serif)*: Digunakan untuk antarmuka sistem, tombol aksi, metadata, navigasi, dan angka.
  * *Scheherazade New (Khat Naskh Klasik)*: Digunakan untuk matan Arab asli, harakat, ibarah, dan Directionality RTL murni.
  * *Audit*: Apakah ada kebocoran font default sistem, font size yang tidak proporsional, atau weight yang bertabrakan?
- **Palet Warna & Kontras Mode Gelap/Terang:**
  * Tema dirancang berbasis *Zenith Canvas* (#FAF9F6 / #0E0E11), *Paper Surface* (#FFFFFF / #141418), dan aksen hangat.
  * *Audit*: Apakah ada warna hardcoded (misal Colors.grey, Colors.black54, Colors.white) yang tidak merespons `isDark`? Apakah ada border ganda (double borders) atau outline yang terlalu tebal dan mengganggu mata?
- **Ritme Spacing & Token Radius:**
  * Standarisasi pada `OTSpacing` (xs:4, sm:8, base:12, md:16, lg:24, xl:32) dan `OTRadius` (chip:8, card:16, dialog:24).
  * *Audit*: Apakah ada padding/margin sembarangan (misal padding 13, 7, 21) yang merusak kerapian ritme visual?
- **Koreografi Animasi & Transisi Bebas Jitter:**
  * Animasi buka-tutup bilik telaah (*Fathul Kitab*), transisi halaman, feedback sentuhan (*AppleInteractiveWrapper*).
  * *Audit*: Apakah ada animasi yang tersendat (*jank*), micro-stutter, atau transformasi skala yang membuat render teks menjadi buram?

#### 2. OVERHAUL COPYWRITING: MEMBASMI TOTAL "AI SLOP" & TEKS TIDAK NATURAL
- **Identifikasi Bahasa AI Slop:**
  * Cari seluruh teks di seluruh file Dart (`lib/**/*.dart`) yang terdengar seperti hasil auto-translate mesin penerjemah, kata-kata marketing generik yang hampa makna, atau gaya asisten AI yang berlebihan (*over-enthusiastic*, menjilat, atau kaku seperti robot).
  * Contoh AI Slop yang harus dieliminasi:
    - Istilah hiperbolis: *"Solusi revolusioner khazanah Islam berbasis kecerdasan buatan mutakhir"*
    - Bahasa terjemahan canggung: *"Masuk sesi autentikasi", "Redeem kode santri", "Jelajahi persona kecerdasan"*
    - Pesan error teknis yang membingungkan orang awam: *"Exception caught during HTTP handshake"*
    - Call-to-action (CTA) yang bertele-tele dan tidak percaya diri.
- **Standarisasi Suara Produk (Tone of Voice: "The Quiet Islamic Scholar"):**
  * Bahasa Indonesia yang tenang, berwibawa, jernih, santun, dan sangat akrab bagi kalangan santri, asatidz, serta peneliti akademis.
  * Istilah turats yang tepat dan beradab: *Ibarah, Marja', Matan, Syarah, Hasyiyah, Takhrij, Bahtsul Masail, Rijalul Hadits, Mu'tamad, Kutubus Sittah*.
  * Teks Arab di layar detail kitab (`book_detail_screen.dart`): Harus fasih, menggunakan istilah bibliografi Islam klasik (`بطاقة الكتاب`, `ترجمة المؤلف`, `دار النشر`, `المحقق`), bukan hasil Google Translate.
- **Tugas Khusus Auditor:**
  * Sajikan **TABEL MATRIKS BEFORE & AFTER COPYWRITING** secara menyeluruh untuk setiap layar:
    1. Beranda / Dashboard (`dashboard_screen.dart`)
    2. Meja Telaah / WebView (`agent_webview_screen.dart`, `agent_room_view.dart`)
    3. Katalog & Detail Kitab (`specialist_list_screen.dart`, `book_detail_screen.dart`)
    4. Layanan Langganan & Paket Tematik (`subscription_screen.dart`)
    5. Profil, Pengaturan & Bantuan (`profile_screen.dart`, dialog-dialog)
    6. Notifikasi, SnackBar, & Pesan Error (`app_snack_bar.dart`, dsb.)

#### 3. ERGONOMI UI / UX & INTERAKSI
- **Ergonomi Sentuhan (Thumb Zone & Tap Targets):**
  * Apakah seluruh tombol interaktif memiliki tap area minimal 44x44 px (atau 48x48 px sesuai Material/Apple HIG)?
  * Apakah tombol-tombol utama di ruang telaah mudah dijangkau dengan satu tangan saat membaca kitab?
- **Navigasi & Predictive Back (PopScope):**
  * Apakah ada celah di mana menekan tombol back saat modal atau ruang telaah terbuka malah menutup aplikasi secara tiba-tiba?
  * Apakah `NavigationGuard` benar-benar mencegah double-push saat pengguna mengetuk tombol berkali-kali secara cepat?
- **Manajemen Tab Meja Telaah (Multi-Tab Zero Reload):**
  * Apakah WebView Google NotebookLM tetap terjaga statusnya di memori saat berpindah tab atau meminimalkan ruang telaah tanpa harus memuat ulang dari awal?

#### 4. KELENGKAPAN FITUR & INTEGRASI SISTEM (FinTech & Langganan)
- **Arsitektur 6 Paket Tematik & GoAkal:**
  * Evaluasi alur checkout langsung (*direct apply links*) dan pemutakhiran *multi-entitlements* di Firestore.
  * Apakah ada kemungkinan status hak akses tidak tersinkronisasi saat pengguna selesai membayar di browser/modal in-app?
- **Device Fingerprinting & Proteksi Anti-Abuse:**
  * Periksa implementasi klaim kode voucher pada `DeviceService` dan `firestore.rules`. Apakah voucher dapat di-exploit menggunakan emulator atau multi-account cloning?

---

### FORMAT LAPORAN AKHIR YANG DIHARAPKAN DARI AUDITOR:

1. **EXECUTIVE SCORECARD (Rapor Mutu 360°)**
   - Berikan nilai huruf (A / B / C / D / F) dan ringkasan kondisi untuk masing-masing aspek:
     * *Konsistensi Desain & Visual Polish*
     * *Ergonomi & Kenyamanan Interaksi (UX)*
     * *Kualitas Copywriting & Bahasa (Anti-AI Slop)*
     * *Arsitektur Kode & Optimasi Performa Flutter*
     * *Keamanan Backend & Transaksi Finansial*
2. **INVENTARISASI DEFECT LENGKAP (Tabel Temuan Bug & Cacat Desain)**
   - Kolom: `ID Cacat` | `Tingkat (P0/P1/P2/P3)` | `Lokasi (File & No. Baris)` | `Akar Masalah` | `Dampak pada Pengguna`
   - *P0*: Fatal / Keamanan bocor / Crash / Hilang uang
   - *P1*: Bug fungsional / Lag berat / UX rusak parah
   - *P2*: Cacat visual / Warna bertabrakan / Padding tidak konsisten
   - *P3*: Ketidakrapian kode / Teks minor
3. **MATRIKS COPYWRITING OVERHAUL KOMPREHENSIF (Before vs After)**
   - Sajikan perbandingan detail teks lama vs teks baru yang sudah dipoles menjadi sangat natural, berwibawa, dan bernuansa santri berilmu tinggi.
4. **ACTIONABLE CODE PATCHES (Perbaikan Kode Siap Pasang)**
   - Berikan blok kode Dart / TypeScript konkret yang siap di-*copy-paste* untuk memperbaiki seluruh temuan P0, P1, dan P2 paling krusial.
5. **ROADMAP TINDAKAN PRIORITAS**
   - Rencana aksi langkah demi langkah bagi tim pengembang untuk mengeksekusi penyempurnaan ini.

```markdown
# Workspace Rules — OpenTurath AI

## 1. Automatic Checkpoint Protocol (MANDATORY)
- **Setiap perubahan sekecil apapun WAJIB langsung dibuatkan check point (Git commit) secara otomatis.**
- Setiap kali file kode, aset, UI, konfigurasi, atau unit test dimodifikasi atau ditambahkan:
  1. Jalankan `git add <files>`
  2. Lakukan commit dengan pesan yang deskriptif dan terstruktur: `git commit -m "<type>(<scope>): <pesan detail perubahan>"`
- Jangan pernah membiarkan perubahan menumpuk tanpa check point.
- Check point harus selalu dibuat secara otomatis tanpa menunggu instruksi tambahan dari pengguna.

## 2. Integritas Build & Release
- Setiap pembuatan APK rilis harus memverifikasi bahwa proses kompilasi Gradle selesai 100% dan file binary rilis yang disalin ke `/Users/apple/Downloads/ramadhan/app-release-latest.apk` memiliki timestamp baru yang valid.
```

```markdown
# OpenTurath AI — Project Handover & Context Snapshot
**Terakhir Diperbarui:** 14 September 2026 (Fase: Transformasi Bahasa & Penyatuan Tone of Voice Quiet Scholar v2 — v1.0.26+27)

Dokumen ini berfungsi sebagai jembatan konteks instan (*zero-friction context handover*). Setiap agen atau sesi chat baru di Antigravity IDE dapat langsung membaca dokumen ini untuk melanjutkan pekerjaan tanpa perlu penjelasan ulang dari pengguna.

---

## 1. Identitas & Batasan Mutlak Proyek (Non-Negotiable)
- **Target Platform**: **Android** (Material 3 Adaptive), **macOS & Windows** (Desktop Adaptive).
- **Versi Rilis Terkini**: **`v1.0.26+27`** (Binary: `/Users/apple/Downloads/ramadhan/app-release-latest.apk`, Size: 60.6 MB, SHA-256: `5e69bfe02881a40fbb66eca733301cff38c195b190ebb724314501bb02254947`).
- **Batasan Eksplisit**:
  - **TIDAK ADA rilis iOS / App Store**.
  - **TIDAK ADA rilis Google Play Store**. Pembaruan aplikasi mandiri via internal updater berbasis SHA-256.
  - **TIDAK ADA open trial bebas** (kuota pertanyaan terbuka). Digantikan dengan **Sistem Voucher Redeem Kode Terkontrol** (`redeemCode`) terintegrasi Google Cloud NotebookLM share invite.
- **Protokol Wajib `AGENTS.md`**:
  - **Rule 1: Automatic Checkpoint Protocol**: Setiap modifikasi sekecil apapun WAJIB langsung di-commit ke Git secara otomatis (`git add <files> && git commit -m "<type>(<scope>): <pesan>"`).
  - **Rule 2: Integritas Build & Release**: Verifikasi 100% proses kompilasi sebelum rilis, update binary rilis dengan timestamp valid.

---

## 2. Status Terkini: 100% Selesai & Terverifikasi (v1.0.26+27)

### A. Transformasi Bahasa & Tone of Voice Kanonikal (Quiet Scholar v2)
1. **Eliminasi Istilah SaaS Produk Internal**:
   - Menghapus frasa kaku seperti *"ruang riset manuskrip AI"*, *"AI Spesialis"*, *"naskah primer terkatalogisasi"*, *"autentikasi sesi riset naskah turats"*, dan *"kurasi kebahasaan"*.
   - Mengganti dengan terminologi tradisi keilmuan yang tenang, bersahaja, dan alami: *"bidang"*, *"asisten"*, *"kitab"*, *"rujukan"*, dan *"hubungkan akun Google"*.
2. **Penyatuan Suara & Tagline Resmi**:
   - Menetapkan satu tagline kanonikal tunggal di seluruh aplikasi: **"Membaca kitab, menelusuri ibarah."** (menghilangkan variasi slogan bahasa Inggris).
3. **Pemisahan Aksi Salin vs Simpan & Integritas Rujukan**:
   - Memisahkan aksi pada menu percakapan: **Salin jawaban** (hanya ke clipboard sistem) dan **Simpan ke Catatan** (ke bookmark lokal).
   - Menghilangkan watermark promosi paksa (*"Disimpan melalui OpenTurath AI..."*) pada sitasi ilmiah guna menjaga otentisitas kutipan turats para peneliti.
4. **Pencegahan Regresi Copywriting UI**:
   - `test/copywriting_test.dart` diperluas dengan scanner regex yang memindai langsung file UI (`subscription_screen.dart`, `google_session_auth_screen.dart`, `profile_screen.dart`, `dashboard_screen.dart`, `library_screen.dart`, dsb.) untuk memastikan kata-kata terlarang tidak muncul kembali.

### B. Keamanan Moneter & Backend Cloud Functions (OT-F001, OT-F003)
1. **Penutupan Celah P0 `all_access`**:
   - `resolvePlanPricing()` menggunakan *strict closed-set whitelist* `PURCHASABLE_AGENTS` dan `MODULE_PLANS`.
   - Caller dilarang keras membeli entitlement global `all_access` atau `all_ai` dengan harga per-modul.
   - `getEntitlementKey()` menolak fallback ke input mentah klien.
2. **Eliminasi Double-Dispatch Provisioning**:
   - Fungsi `redeemCode` mencatat job berstatus `pending` ke `provisioning_outbox` secara atomik di dalam transaksi Firestore.
   - Panggilan langsung ke Cloud Run di luar transaksi dihapus; outbox worker `processProvisioningOutbox` (ber-lease dan ber-retry) menjadi *single source of truth*.
   - Kode voucher mentah pada notifikasi Telegram direduksi (`***`).

### C. Restorasi Performa UI & Animasi Ruang AI Bebas Lag (OT-F007, OT-F019)
1. **Pembersihan GPU Overhead**:
   - Menghapus `Transform.scale` pada seluruh `baseScaffold` (mencegah rasterisasi ulang pohon widget Dashboard/Navigasi pada setiap frame).
   - Menghapus `ScaleTransition` pada `AgentMultiTabRoom` (mencegah deformasi tekstur native Android PlatformView Chromium/WebView yang memicu lag dan stuttering).
2. **Animasi Geser Vertikal Murni (240ms)**:
   - Transisi vertikal murni sumbu Y (`0.12` ➔ `0.0`) dengan kurva `Curves.easeOutCubic` berdurasi 240 ms (penutupan 200 ms). Berjalan stabil di 60/120 FPS pada perangkat Android fisik.
   - Mendukung `MediaQuery.disableAnimations` untuk aksesibilitas *reduced motion*.
3. **Penutupan Double-Back Race Window (OT-F007)**:
   - `PopScope` di `MainShellScreen` memvalidasi `_roomAnimController.isDismissed`. Ketukan Back kedua saat animasi penutupan berlangsung diserap aman dan tidak menutup aplikasi.

### D. Keamanan Payment WebView & Kepatuhan Legal (OT-F005, OT-F006)
1. **Destination Allowlist DOKU Sheet**:
   - `shouldOverrideUrlLoading` memvalidasi skema `https` dan membatasi rute navigasi hanya ke domain resmi DOKU (`*.doku.com`, `*.doku.id`) dan domain aplikasi OpenTurath (`openturath-ai.web.app`, `openturath.ai`). URL di luar itu dibatalkan (`CANCEL`).
2. **Keselarasan Privasi & Penyimpanan**:
   - Teks pada `legal_copy.dart` dan `public/privacy.html` dikoreksi secara faktual menjadi *"penyimpanan aplikasi secara lokal pada perangkat Anda"*.

### E. Integritas Data Bibliografis Turats (OT-F011)
- Konsistensi identitas pengarang dan tahun wafat pada `canonical_syafii.json` divalidasi 100%:
  - *Al-Hidayah ila Auham al-Kifayah*: Atribusi kanonikal Al-Isnawi (w. 772 H).
  - *Bidayat al-Muhtaj fi Syarh al-Minhaj*: Atribusi kanonikal Ibnu Qadhi Syuhbah (w. 874 H).
  - *Ithaf al-Arib bi Syarh al-Ghayah wa at-Taqrib*: Atribusi kanonikal Asy-Syabrawi bin Abi al-Ma'athi.
```

## DOKUMEN: .github/workflows/release_all_platforms.yml
```yaml
name: Release Multiplatform (APK, EXE, DMG)

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 1. BUILD WINDOWS EXE (Installer & Portable Zip)
  # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  build-windows-exe:
    name: Build Windows EXE
    runs-on: windows-latest
    env:
      CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM: "3.5"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Enable Windows Desktop
        run: flutter config --enable-windows-desktop

      - name: Get dependencies
        run: |
          cd openturath_ai
          flutter pub get

      - name: Build Windows Release
        env:
          CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM: "3.5"
        run: |
          cd openturath_ai
          flutter build windows --release

      - name: Compress Windows Release Bundle
        run: |
          Compress-Archive -Path openturath_ai\build\windows\x64\runner\Release\* -DestinationPath openturath_ai\build\windows\OpenTurath_AI_Windows_x64.zip

      - name: Upload Windows EXE Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: OpenTurath-AI-Windows-x64
          path: openturath_ai/build/windows/OpenTurath_AI_Windows_x64.zip

  # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 2. BUILD MACOS DMG (Disk Image Installer)
  # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  build-macos-dmg:
    name: Build macOS DMG
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Enable macOS Desktop
        run: flutter config --enable-macos-desktop

      - name: Get dependencies
        run: |
          cd openturath_ai
          flutter pub get

      - name: Build macOS Release
        run: |
          cd openturath_ai
          flutter build macos --release

      - name: Package DMG Installer
        run: |
          cd openturath_ai/build/macos/Build/Products/Release
          mkdir -p dmg_folder
          cp -r openturath_ai.app dmg_folder/
          ln -s /Applications dmg_folder/Applications
          hdiutil create -volname "OpenTurath AI" -srcfolder dmg_folder -ov -format UDZO OpenTurath_AI_macOS.dmg

      - name: Upload macOS DMG Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: OpenTurath-AI-macOS-DMG
          path: openturath_ai/build/macos/Build/Products/Release/OpenTurath_AI_macOS.dmg

  # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # 3. BUILD ANDROID APK
  # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  build-apk:
    name: Build Android APK
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Grant Executable Permission to Gradlew
        run: chmod +x openturath_ai/android/gradlew

      - name: Get dependencies
        run: |
          cd openturath_ai
          flutter pub get

      - name: Build APK Release
        run: |
          cd openturath_ai
          flutter build apk --release

      - name: Upload APK Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: OpenTurath-AI-Android-APK
          path: openturath_ai/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk

```

## DOKUMEN: openturath_ai/pubspec.yaml
```yaml
name: openturath_ai
description: "OpenTurath AI - الذكاء الاصطناعي للعلوم الإسلامية"
publish_to: 'none'
version: 1.0.48+49

environment:
  sdk: '>=3.0.0 <4.0.0'

dependencies:
```

## DOKUMEN: openturath_ai/windows/CMakeLists.txt
```markdown
# Project-level configuration.
set(CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM "3.5" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(openturath_ai LANGUAGES CXX)

# The name of the executable created for the application. Change this to change
# the on-disk name of your application.
set(BINARY_NAME "openturath_ai")

# Explicitly opt in to modern CMake behaviors to avoid warnings with recent
# versions of CMake.
cmake_policy(VERSION 3.14...3.25)

# Define build configuration option.
get_property(IS_MULTICONFIG GLOBAL PROPERTY GENERATOR_IS_MULTI_CONFIG)
if(IS_MULTICONFIG)
  set(CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES "Debug;Profile;Release"
    CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
else()
  if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Debug" CACHE
      STRING "Flutter build mode" FORCE)
    set_property(CACHE CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE PROPERTY STRINGS
      "Debug" "Profile" "Release")
  endif()
endif()
# Define settings for the Profile build mode.
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_PROFILE "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_RELEASE}")
set(CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS_PROFILE "${CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS_RELEASE}")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_PROFILE "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE}")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_PROFILE "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE}")

# Use Unicode for all projects.
add_definitions(-DUNICODE -D_UNICODE)

# Compilation settings that should be applied to most targets.
#
# Be cautious about adding new options here, as plugins use this function by
# default. In most cases, you should add new options to specific targets instead
# of modifying this function.
function(APPLY_STANDARD_SETTINGS TARGET)
  target_compile_features(${TARGET} PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
  target_compile_options(${TARGET} PRIVATE /W4 /WX /wd"4100")
  target_compile_options(${TARGET} PRIVATE /EHsc)
  target_compile_definitions(${TARGET} PRIVATE "_HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0")
  target_compile_definitions(${TARGET} PRIVATE "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:_DEBUG>")
endfunction()

# Flutter library and tool build rules.
set(FLUTTER_MANAGED_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/flutter")
add_subdirectory(${FLUTTER_MANAGED_DIR})

# Application build; see runner/CMakeLists.txt.
add_subdirectory("runner")


# Generated plugin build rules, which manage building the plugins and adding
# them to the application.
include(flutter/generated_plugins.cmake)


# === Installation ===
# Support files are copied into place next to the executable, so that it can
# run in place. This is done instead of making a separate bundle (as on Linux)
# so that building and running from within Visual Studio will work.
set(BUILD_BUNDLE_DIR "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${BINARY_NAME}>")
# Make the "install" step default, as it's required to run.
set(CMAKE_VS_INCLUDE_INSTALL_TO_DEFAULT_BUILD 1)
if(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX_INITIALIZED_TO_DEFAULT)
  set(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX "${BUILD_BUNDLE_DIR}" CACHE PATH "..." FORCE)
endif()

set(INSTALL_BUNDLE_DATA_DIR "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/data")
set(INSTALL_BUNDLE_LIB_DIR "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")

install(TARGETS ${BINARY_NAME} RUNTIME DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}"
  COMPONENT Runtime)

install(FILES "${FLUTTER_ICU_DATA_FILE}" DESTINATION "${INSTALL_BUNDLE_DATA_DIR}"
  COMPONENT Runtime)

install(FILES "${FLUTTER_LIBRARY}" DESTINATION "${INSTALL_BUNDLE_LIB_DIR}"
  COMPONENT Runtime)

if(PLUGIN_BUNDLED_LIBRARIES)
  install(FILES "${PLUGIN_BUNDLED_LIBRARIES}"
    DESTINATION "${INSTALL_BUNDLE_LIB_DIR}"
    COMPONENT Runtime)
endif()

# Copy the native assets provided by the build.dart from all packages.
set(NATIVE_ASSETS_DIR "${PROJECT_BUILD_DIR}native_assets/windows/")
install(DIRECTORY "${NATIVE_ASSETS_DIR}"
   DESTINATION "${INSTALL_BUNDLE_LIB_DIR}"
   COMPONENT Runtime)

# Fully re-copy the assets directory on each build to avoid having stale files
# from a previous install.
set(FLUTTER_ASSET_DIR_NAME "flutter_assets")
install(CODE "
  file(REMOVE_RECURSE \"${INSTALL_BUNDLE_DATA_DIR}/${FLUTTER_ASSET_DIR_NAME}\")
  " COMPONENT Runtime)
install(DIRECTORY "${PROJECT_BUILD_DIR}/${FLUTTER_ASSET_DIR_NAME}"
  DESTINATION "${INSTALL_BUNDLE_DATA_DIR}" COMPONENT Runtime)

# Install the AOT library on non-Debug builds only.
install(FILES "${AOT_LIBRARY}" DESTINATION "${INSTALL_BUNDLE_DATA_DIR}"
  CONFIGURATIONS Profile;Release
  COMPONENT Runtime)
```

## BERKAS BACKEND: openturath_ai/firestore.rules
```javascript
rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {

    // ================================================================
    // USERS: perangkat hanya boleh membuat profil trial. Kuota, plan, masa
    // berlaku, dan entitlement hanya boleh diubah oleh Admin SDK/Cloud Functions.
    // ================================================================
    match /users/{userId} {
      // Boleh baca jika login dan uid sama
      allow read: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;

      // CREATE: AuthService membuat profil trial ketika login pertama.
      // Nilai akses harus terkunci sejak dokumen pertama dibuat. Entitlements TIDAK boleh disuntik klien.
      allow create: if request.auth != null
        && request.auth.uid == userId
        && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly([
          'name', 'email', 'photo_url', 'plan', 'questions_used',
          'subscription_expiry', 'entitlements', 'pending_deletion', 'pending_deletion_at'
        ])
        && (
          (request.auth.token.firebase.sign_in_provider != 'anonymous' && request.resource.data.email == request.auth.token.email) ||
          (request.auth.token.firebase.sign_in_provider == 'anonymous' && (!('email' in request.resource.data) || request.resource.data.email == null || request.resource.data.email == ''))
        )
        && request.resource.data.plan == 'trial'
        && request.resource.data.questions_used == 0
        && request.resource.data.subscription_expiry == null
        && (!('photo_url' in request.resource.data) || request.resource.data.photo_url == null || request.resource.data.photo_url.size() <= 1000)
        && (!('entitlements' in request.resource.data) || request.resource.data.entitlements == {});

      // UPDATE: Hanya diizinkan untuk menandai pending_deletion saat penghapusan akun
      allow update: if request.auth != null
        && request.auth.uid == userId
        && request.resource.data.diff(resource.data).affectedKeys().hasOnly(['pending_deletion', 'pending_deletion_at'])
        && request.resource.data.pending_deletion == true;

      // DELETE: Pengguna boleh menghapus datanya sendiri
      allow delete: if false;

      // Sub-koleksi chat / conversations milik user
      match /conversations/{convId} {
        allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
        
        match /messages/{msgId} {
          allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
        }
      }

      // Sub-koleksi bookmarks / catatan riset milik user
      match /bookmarks/{bookmarkId} {
        allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
      }
    }

    // ================================================================
    // CLIENT ERROR LOGS (Telemetry & Crash Reports - Write Only)
    // ================================================================
    match /client_error_logs/{logId} {
      allow create: if request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly([
        'error', 'context', 'severity', 'stackTrace', 'breadcrumbs',
        'extra', 'userId', 'userEmail', 'platform', 'deviceTimestamp', 'createdAt'
      ])
      && request.resource.data.error is string
      && request.resource.data.error.size() <= 2500
      && request.resource.data.severity in ['info', 'warning', 'error', 'critical']
      && (
        (request.auth != null && request.resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid) ||
        (request.auth == null && request.resource.data.userId == 'unauthenticated')
      )
      && request.resource.data.createdAt == request.time;
      allow read, update, delete: if false;
    }

    // ================================================================
    // APP CONFIG (Termasuk Dynamic Script & Info Aplikasi)
    // ================================================================
    match /app_config/{configId} {
      allow read: if true;
      allow write: if false;
    }

    // ================================================================
    // TRANSACTIONS: Hanya server / webhook yang boleh create/update
    // ================================================================
    match /transactions/{transactionId} {
      allow read: if request.auth != null && (resource == null || resource.data.uid == request.auth.uid);
      allow write: if false;
    }

    // ================================================================
    // SERVER-ONLY COLLECTIONS (Redeem, Webhook, Outbox, Rate Limits)
    // ================================================================
    match /redeem_codes/{codeId} {
      allow read, write: if false;
      match /{allSubcollections=**} {
        allow read, write: if false;
      }
    }

    match /redeem_attempts/{uid} {
      allow read, write: if false;
    }

    match /rate_limits/{limitId} {
      allow read, write: if false;
    }

    match /provisioning_outbox/{jobId} {
      allow read, write: if false;
    }

    match /webhook_events/{eventId} {
      allow read, write: if false;
    }

    // ================================================================
    // DEFAULT: Tolak akses lainnya
    // ================================================================
    match /{document=**} {
      allow read, write: if false;
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
export interface ResolvedNotebook {
  url: string;
  notebookId: string;
  cloneName: string;
  entityCode: string;
  isMaster: boolean;
  cloneIndex?: number;
}

/**
 * Consistent hashing DJB2 untuk menjaga agar user selalu terhubung
 * ke kloning notebook yang sama (sticky session), sekaligus menyebarkan
 * beban secara merata ke seluruh 13 kloning ($1/13 \approx 7.7\%$ per notebook).
 */
export function hashString(str: string): number {
  let hash = 5381;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    hash = ((hash << 5) + hash) + str.charCodeAt(i);
    hash = hash & hash; // Convert to 32bit int
  }
  return Math.abs(hash);
}

/**
 * Resolves optimal notebook URL for a given agentId and optional user UID.
 */
export function resolveAgentNotebook(agentId: string, uid?: string): ResolvedNotebook | null {
  const entityCode = AGENT_TO_ENTITY[agentId];
  if (!entityCode) return null;

  const entity = NOTEBOOK_ENTITIES[entityCode];
  if (!entity) return null;

  if (uid && entity.clones && entity.clones.length > 0) {
    const cloneIndex = hashString(`${uid}:${agentId}`) % entity.clones.length;
    const clone = entity.clones[cloneIndex];
    return {
      url: clone.url,
      notebookId: clone.id,
      cloneName: clone.name,
      entityCode,
      isMaster: false,
      cloneIndex,
    };
  }

  // Default ke Master jika tanpa UID atau belum ada klon
  return {
    url: entity.masterUrl,
    notebookId: entity.masterId,
    cloneName: `${entity.name} (Master)`,
    entityCode,
    isMaster: true,
  };
}
```

```typescript
async function sendTelegramNotification(text: string): Promise<void> {
  const token = process.env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN;
  const chatId = process.env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID;
  if (!token || !chatId) return;

  try {
    await axios.post(
      `https://api.telegram.org/bot${token}/sendMessage`,
      {
        chat_id: chatId,
        text,
        parse_mode: "HTML",
      },
      { timeout: 5000 }
    );
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("[Telegram] Failed to send notification:", err?.message || err);
  }
}

function getEntitlementKey(agentId: string): string {
  const entitlementKey = AGENT_ENTITLEMENTS[agentId];
  if (!entitlementKey) {
    // OT-F001: Jangan pernah mengembalikan input mentah client untuk mencegah privilege escalation
    return "";
  }
  return entitlementKey;
}

export function addCalendarMonthsClamped(baseDate: Date, months: number): Date {
  const result = new Date(baseDate.getTime());
  const originalDay = result.getDate();
  result.setDate(1);
  result.setMonth(result.getMonth() + months);
  const maxDays = new Date(result.getFullYear(), result.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate();
  result.setDate(Math.min(originalDay, maxDays));
  return result;
}

function getEntitlementAccess(userData: FirebaseFirestore.DocumentData, entitlementKey: string): { premiumPlan: boolean; active: boolean } {
  if (userData.account_deleted === true) return {premiumPlan:false,active:false};
  const entitlements = userData.entitlements && typeof userData.entitlements === "object"
    ? userData.entitlements as Record<string, any> : {};
  const now = Date.now();
  const active = (ent: any): boolean => {
    if (!ent || typeof ent.plan !== "string") return false;
    if (ent.status === "revoked" || ent.status === "expired") return false;
    const allowed = /^(trial|tholib(?:_1m|_6m)?|bahits(?:_1y)?|premium|all_access|all_ai.*|single|sultan|pro|voucher(?:_.*)?|redeem(?:_.*)?|custom|full)$/.test(ent.plan);
    const expiry = ent.expiry?.toDate ? ent.expiry.toDate() : (ent.expiry?._seconds ? new Date(ent.expiry._seconds * 1000) : new Date(ent.expiry ?? ""));
    return allowed && Number.isFinite(expiry.getTime()) && expiry.getTime() > now;
  };
  const all = entitlements.all_access ?? entitlements.all_ai;
  if (active(all)) return { premiumPlan: true, active: true };
  const specific = entitlements[entitlementKey];
  if (active(specific)) return { premiumPlan: true, active: true };

  // Only explicit revocation of all_access blocks global subscription fallback
  if (all && all.status === "revoked") {
    return { premiumPlan: true, active: false };
  }

  // Account-level active subscription
  const expiry = userData.subscription_expiry?.toDate
    ? userData.subscription_expiry.toDate() : new Date(userData.subscription_expiry ?? "");
  const isGlobalExpiryValid = Number.isFinite(expiry.getTime()) && expiry.getTime() > now;

  const globalPlanPattern = /^(all_access|all_ai.*|full|sultan|tholib.*|bahits.*|premium|pro|custom|voucher.*|redeem.*)$/;
  const isGlobalPlan = typeof userData.plan === "string" && globalPlanPattern.test(userData.plan);

  if (isGlobalPlan && isGlobalExpiryValid) {
    return { premiumPlan: true, active: true };
  }

  if (userData.plan === "single") {
    return { premiumPlan: !!specific, active: false };
  }

  const legacy = ["all_access", "all_ai_1m", "all_ai_6m", "all_ai_1y", "all_ai", "full", "sultan", "tholib_1m", "tholib_6m", "bahits_1y", "tholib", "bahits", "premium", "pro", "custom"].includes(userData.plan);
  return { premiumPlan: legacy, active: legacy && isGlobalExpiryValid };
}

// ================================================================
// FUNCTION 1: getAgentUrl
// Dipanggil oleh Flutter saat user membuka agent
// ================================================================
export const getAgentUrl = functions
  .runWith({ serviceAccount: "open-turath@appspot.gserviceaccount.com" })
  .https.onCall(async (data, context) => {
    if (!context.auth) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
        "unauthenticated",
        "Login diperlukan untuk mengakses agent."
      );
    }

    const uid = context.auth.uid;
    await enforceRateLimit(
      `agent_url_${uid}`,
      60,
      60,
      "Terlalu banyak permintaan membuka asisten. Silakan coba kembali sebentar lagi."
    );
    const agentId = data.agentId as string;

    if (!agentId) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
        "invalid-argument",
        "agentId diperlukan."
      );
    }

    const resolved = resolveAgentNotebook(agentId, uid);
    const url = resolved ? resolved.url : AGENT_URLS[agentId];
    if (!url) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
        "not-found",
        "Agent tidak ditemukan atau belum aktif."
      );
    }

    const userDoc = await db.collection("users").doc(uid).get();
    if (!userDoc.exists) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError("not-found", "User tidak ditemukan.");
    }

    const userData = userDoc.data()!;
    const questionsUsed = (userData.questions_used as number) || 0;
    const entitlementKey = getEntitlementKey(agentId);

    const entitlementAccess = getEntitlementAccess(userData, entitlementKey);
    if (entitlementAccess.active) {
      return {
        url,
        notebookId: resolved?.notebookId,
        cloneName: resolved?.cloneName,
        entityCode: resolved?.entityCode,
        isMaster: resolved?.isMaster,
      };
    }

    throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
      "permission-denied",
      "Akses modul riset ini membutuhkan langganan aktif atau kode redeem santri. Silakan berlangganan atau masukkan kode akses untuk melanjutkan."
    );
  });

// ================================================================
// FUNCTION 1b: recordQuestion
// Trial sekarang berbasis masa berlaku voucher, bukan kuota pertanyaan.
// ================================================================
export const recordQuestion = functions
  .runWith({ serviceAccount: "open-turath@appspot.gserviceaccount.com" })
  .https.onCall(async (data, context) => {
    if (!context.auth) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError("unauthenticated", "Login diperlukan.");
    }
    const agentId = data.agentId as string;
    const resolved = resolveAgentNotebook(agentId);
    if (!agentId || (!resolved && !AGENT_URLS[agentId])) {
      throw new functions.https.HttpsError("not-found", "Kajian tidak ditemukan atau belum aktif.");
    }
    const entitlementKey = getEntitlementKey(agentId);
    const userRef = db.collection("users").doc(context.auth.uid);

    return db.runTransaction(async (transaction) => {
      const snapshot = await transaction.get(userRef);
      if (!snapshot.exists) {
        throw new functions.https.HttpsError("not-found", "User tidak ditemukan.");
      }
      const userData = snapshot.data()!;
      const entitlementAccess = getEntitlementAccess(userData, entitlementKey);
      if (entitlementAccess.active) {
        return { isPremium: true, questionsUsed: userData.questions_used || 0, questionsRemaining: null };
      }
      if (entitlementAccess.premiumPlan) {
        throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
          "permission-denied",
          "Langganan Anda untuk kajian ini telah berakhir."
        );
      }

      throw new functions.https.HttpsError(
        "permission-denied",
        "Akses Pro untuk kajian ini belum aktif. Tukarkan voucher atau berlangganan untuk melanjutkan."
      );
    });
  });

// ================================================================
// DOKU PAYMENT GATEWAY INTEGRATION
```
