```dart
/// Gerbang Sesi Google (Pre-Auth Gate)
/// Memastikan kuki autentikasi Google aktif di WebView sehingga pengguna
/// langsung dapat membuka NotebookLM tanpa kendala masuk berulang.
class GoogleSessionAuthScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const GoogleSessionAuthScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<GoogleSessionAuthScreen> createState() =>
      _GoogleSessionAuthScreenState();
}

class _GoogleSessionAuthScreenState extends State<GoogleSessionAuthScreen> {
  InAppWebViewController? _webController;
  bool _isSessionReady = false;
  final ValueNotifier<double> _loadProgress = ValueNotifier<double>(0.0);

  static const String _chromeUserAgent =
      "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14; Mobile) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/128.0.6613.127 Mobile Safari/537.36";

  static const String _targetLoginUrl =
      "https://accounts.google.com/ServiceLogin?continue=https://notebook.google.com/";

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _loadProgress.dispose();
    _webController = null;
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// Simpan status sesi dan arahkan ke Dashboard
  Future<void> _onSessionAuthenticated() async {
    if (!mounted || _isSessionReady) return;
    setState(() => _isSessionReady = true);

    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setBool('google_session_ready', true);
    } catch (_) {}

    if (!mounted) return;
    Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, AppRoutes.dashboard);
  }

  Future<void> _confirmCancelAndSignOut() async {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final shouldSignOut = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: isDark ? AppTheme.surfaceCardDark : AppTheme.surfaceCardLight,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusCard)),
        title: Text(
          AppCopy.cancelSignInTitle,
          style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            color: isDark ? AppTheme.textPrimaryDark : AppTheme.textPrimaryLight,
          ),
        ),
        content: Text(
          AppCopy.googleSessionSignInSameAccountDesc,
          style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
            fontSize: 13,
            color: isDark ? AppTheme.textSecondaryDark : AppTheme.textSecondaryLight,
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: Text(
              AppCopy.stayHere,
              style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                color: isDark ? AppTheme.accentDark : AppTheme.accentLight,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: AppTheme.appleRed,
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusPill)),
            ),
            child: Text(
              AppCopy.exit,
              style: GoogleFonts.outfit(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (shouldSignOut == true && mounted) {
      await AuthService().signOut();
      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, AppRoutes.login);
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = isDark ? AppTheme.canvasDark : AppTheme.canvasLight;
    final surface = isDark ? AppTheme.surfaceCardDark : AppTheme.surfaceCardLight;
    final border = isDark ? AppTheme.borderDark : AppTheme.borderLight;
    final textPrimary = isDark ? AppTheme.textPrimaryDark : AppTheme.textPrimaryLight;
    final textSecondary = isDark ? AppTheme.textSecondaryDark : AppTheme.textSecondaryLight;
    final accent = isDark ? AppTheme.accentDark : AppTheme.accentLight;

    if (_isSessionReady) {
      return Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        body: const Center(
          child: AppLoader(
            title: AppCopy.googleSessionConnected,
            subtitle: AppCopy.googleSessionPreparing,
            dotSize: 10,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return PopScope(
      canPop: false,
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, result) async {
        if (didPop) return;
        final canGoBack = await _webController?.canGoBack() ?? false;
        if (!mounted) return;
        if (canGoBack) {
          await _webController?.goBack();
        } else {
          await _confirmCancelAndSignOut();
        }
      },
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        appBar: AppBar(
          backgroundColor: canvas,
          elevation: 0,
          scrolledUnderElevation: 0,
          title: Text(
            AppCopy.googleSessionConnectTitle,
            style: GoogleFonts.newsreader(
              fontSize: 18,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: textPrimary,
              letterSpacing: -0.2,
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            IconButton(
              tooltip: AppCopy.exit,
              icon: Icon(Icons.logout_rounded, size: 20, color: textSecondary),
              onPressed: _confirmCancelAndSignOut,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
          ],
          bottom: PreferredSize(
            preferredSize: const Size.fromHeight(2),
            child: ValueListenableBuilder<double>(
              valueListenable: _loadProgress,
              builder: (context, progress, child) {
                if (progress >= 1.0) return const SizedBox(height: 2);
                return LinearProgressIndicator(
                  value: progress,
                  backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
                  valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(accent),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: Column(
            children: [
              // Banner Penjelasan Transparan
              Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 10),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: surface,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusCard),
                  border: Border.all(color: border, width: 0.8),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded, size: 18, color: accent),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        AppCopy.googleSessionSignInHint,
                        style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                          fontSize: 12,
                          height: 1.35,
                          color: textSecondary,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              Expanded(
                child: Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 0, 12, 12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: surface,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusCard),
                    border: Border.all(color: border, width: 1),
                  ),
                  clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
                  child: InAppWebView(
                    initialUrlRequest: URLRequest(url: WebUri(_targetLoginUrl)),
                    initialSettings: InAppWebViewSettings(
                      userAgent: _chromeUserAgent,
                      javaScriptEnabled: true,
                      domStorageEnabled: true,
                      databaseEnabled: true,
                      sharedCookiesEnabled: true,
                      thirdPartyCookiesEnabled: true,
                      useHybridComposition: true,
                      supportMultipleWindows: false,
                      useShouldOverrideUrlLoading: true,
                      javaScriptCanOpenWindowsAutomatically: false,
                      mixedContentMode: MixedContentMode.MIXED_CONTENT_NEVER_ALLOW,
                      allowFileAccess: false,
                      allowContentAccess: false,
                      forceDark: isDark ? ForceDark.ON : ForceDark.OFF,
                      algorithmicDarkeningAllowed: false,
                    ),
                    shouldOverrideUrlLoading: (controller, navigationAction) async {
                      final uri = navigationAction.request.url;
                      if (uri == null) return NavigationActionPolicy.CANCEL;

                      return NotebookNavigation.allowed(uri)
                          ? NavigationActionPolicy.ALLOW : NavigationActionPolicy.CANCEL;
                    },
                    onWebViewCreated: (controller) => _webController = controller,
                    onProgressChanged: (controller, progress) {
                      if (mounted) _loadProgress.value = progress / 100;
                    },
                    onLoadStop: (controller, url) async {
                      if (!mounted || url == null) return;
                      final urlStr = url.toString();

                      final cookieManager = CookieManager.instance();
                      final cookies = await cookieManager.getCookies(
                        url: WebUri("https://notebook.google.com"),
                      );
                      final hasSession = cookies.any((c) =>
                          c.name == 'SID' ||
                          c.name == 'HSID' ||
                          c.name == 'SSID' ||
                          c.name == 'OSID');

                      if (hasSession ||
                          (NotebookNavigation.notebook(url) &&
                              !urlStr.contains('ServiceLogin') &&
                              !urlStr.contains('signin'))) {
                        await _onSessionAuthenticated();
                      }
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:async';

/// Full screen view for the research library.
class LibraryScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const LibraryScreen({super.key, this.agent});

class _LibraryScreenState extends State<LibraryScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  final CanonicalLibraryService _service = CanonicalLibraryService.instance;
  Timer? _searchDebounce;

  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? _allBooks;
  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? _filteredBooks;
  bool _isLoading = true;
  String? _errorMessage;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadData();
    _searchController.addListener(_onSearchChanged);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchDebounce?.cancel();
    _searchController.removeListener(_onSearchChanged);
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onSearchChanged() {
    _searchDebounce?.cancel();
    _searchDebounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 200), () {
      if (_allBooks == null || !mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _filteredBooks = _service.filterBooks(
          _allBooks!,
          _searchController.text,
        );
      });
    });
  }

  Future<void> _loadData() async {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _errorMessage = null;
    });

    try {
      final books = await _service.loadSyafiiCatalog();
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _allBooks = books;
        _filteredBooks = books;
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _errorMessage = 'Katalog rujukan belum dapat dimuat saat ini.';
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  void _showEditionDetails(CanonicalBookPresentation book) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);

    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      useRootNavigator: true,
      backgroundColor: surface,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
      ),
      builder: (ctx) {
        return SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(OTSpacing.lg),
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        'Detail edisi',
                        style: OTTypography.sectionHeading(color: textSecondary),
                      ),
                      IconButton(
                        icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: textSecondary),
                        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.sm),
                  Text(
                    book.titleArabic,
                    textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                    textAlign: TextAlign.right,
                    style: OTTypography.arabicReading(color: textPrimary).copyWith(
                      fontSize: 22,
                      height: 1.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.xs),
                  Text(
                    book.authorArabic,
                    textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                    textAlign: TextAlign.right,
                    style: OTTypography.arabicReading(color: textSecondary).copyWith(
                      fontSize: 16,
                      height: 1.4,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.base),
                  Divider(color: border, height: 1),
                  const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.base),
                  if (book.verifiedDeathYearHijri != null)
                    _detailRow('Tahun Wafat', '${book.verifiedDeathYearHijri} H', textPrimary, textSecondary),
                  if (book.reviewedTypeLabel != null)
                    _detailRow('Jenis kitab', book.reviewedTypeLabel!, textPrimary, textSecondary),
                  if (book.reviewedEraLabel != null)
                    _detailRow('Periode', book.reviewedEraLabel!, textPrimary, textSecondary),
                  if (book.volumesCount != null)
                    _detailRow('Jumlah Jilid', '${book.volumesCount} Jilid', textPrimary, textSecondary),
                  if (book.publisher != null && book.publisher!.isNotEmpty)
                    _detailRow('Penerbit', book.publisher!, textPrimary, textSecondary),
                  if (book.muhaqqiq != null && book.muhaqqiq!.isNotEmpty)
                    _detailRow('Tahqiq / Editor', book.muhaqqiq!, textPrimary, textSecondary),
                  _detailRow('ID edisi', book.editionId, textPrimary, textSecondary),
                  const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.base),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },

  }

  Widget _detailRow(String label, String value, Color textPrimary, Color textSecondary) {

  @override
```

```dart
class _LoginScreenState extends State<LoginScreen> {
  final AuthService _authService = AuthService();
  bool _isLoading = false;
  late final TapGestureRecognizer _termsRecognizer;
  late final TapGestureRecognizer _privacyRecognizer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _termsRecognizer = TapGestureRecognizer()
      ..onTap = () => _openLegalUrl('https://openturath.ai/terms');
    _privacyRecognizer = TapGestureRecognizer()
      ..onTap = () => _openLegalUrl('https://openturath.ai/privacy');
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _termsRecognizer.dispose();
    _privacyRecognizer.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _openLegalUrl(String url) async {
    final uri = Uri.parse(url);
    try {
      if (!await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication)) {
        await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.platformDefault);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        AppSnackBar.error(context, 'Tidak dapat membuka tautan halaman.');
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _signIn() async {
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    try {
      final user = await _authService.signInWithGoogle();
      if (!mounted || user == null) return;
      Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, AppRoutes.googleSessionAuth);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final message = e.toString().contains('network') || e.toString().contains('SocketException')
          ? AppCopy.networkError
          : AppCopy.googleSignInFailed;
      AppSnackBar.error(context, message);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  Widget _stagger({required int delayMs, required Widget child}) {
    return TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
      tween: Tween(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0),
      duration: Duration(milliseconds: 350 + delayMs),
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      builder: (context, value, animChild) {
        return Transform.translate(
          offset: Offset(0, 18 * (1 - value)),
          child: Opacity(
            opacity: value.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
            child: animChild,
          ),
        );
      },
      child: child,
    );
  }

  @override

    const bg = AppTheme.canvasDark;
    const textPrimary = AppTheme.textPrimaryDark;
    const textMuted = AppTheme.textSecondaryDark;

      value: const SystemUiOverlayStyle(
        statusBarColor: Colors.transparent,
        statusBarIconBrightness: Brightness.light,
        systemNavigationBarColor: bg,
        systemNavigationBarIconBrightness: Brightness.light,
      ),
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: bg,
        body: SafeArea(
        child: Center(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 28, vertical: 32),
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 380),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),

                  // ── 1. Visual Symbol: Arch Artwork dengan Fade Bawah Mulus ──
                  _stagger(
                    delayMs: 40,
                    child: SizedBox(
                      height: 170,
                      width: 170,
                      child: ShaderMask(
                        shaderCallback: (rect) {
                          return const LinearGradient(
                            begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                            end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                            colors: [Colors.black, Colors.black, Colors.transparent],
                            stops: [0.0, 0.86, 1.0],
                          ).createShader(rect);
                        },
                        blendMode: BlendMode.dstIn,
                        child: Image.asset(
                          'assets/images/arch_dark_transparent.png',
                          fit: BoxFit.contain,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 20),

                  // ── 2. Brand Wordmark: "OpenTurath" ──
                  _stagger(
                    delayMs: 90,
```

```dart
    _pageController.dispose();
    super.dispose();

  void _onTabSelected(int index, {String? fieldId, CorpusKind? kind}) {
    AppSnackBar.clear(context);
    if (_pageController.hasClients && _currentIndex != index) {
      _pageController.animateToPage(
        index,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
        curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      );
    }
    setState(() {
      _currentIndex = index;
      _selectedFieldId = fieldId;
      _selectedKind = kind;
    });
  }

  List<Widget> _buildScreens() {
    final field = _selectedFieldId != null
        ? FieldModel.defaultFields.firstWhere(
            (f) => f.id == _selectedFieldId,
            orElse: () => FieldModel.defaultFields.first,
          )
        : null;

    return [
      const DashboardScreen(),
      SpecialistListScreen(
        key: ValueKey('${_selectedFieldId}_${_selectedKind?.name}'),
        field: field,

          return PopScope(
            // canPop hanya diizinkan jika ruang tertutup DAN sedang di tab 0
            canPop: !sessionManager.isOpen && _currentIndex == 0,
            onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, result) async {
              if (didPop) return;

                final activeController = sessionManager.activeTab?.webController;

                    maintainAnimation: true,
                    maintainSize: true,

class _GoogleNavBarItem extends StatelessWidget {
  final IconData icon;
  final IconData activeIcon;
  final String label;
  final bool isSelected;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  const _GoogleNavBarItem({
    required this.icon,
    required this.activeIcon,
    required this.label,
    required this.isSelected,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final activeBg = isDark ? Colors.white : const Color(0xFF18181B);
    final activeFg = isDark ? const Color(0xFF18181B) : Colors.white;
    final unselected = isDark ? const Color(0xFF94A3B8) : const Color(0xFF64748B);
    final labelColor = isSelected
        ? (isDark ? Colors.white : const Color(0xFF18181B))
        : unselected;

    return InkWell(
      onTap: () {
        HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
        onTap();

    );
  }
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// Focused reading surface: the archive list remains an index, not an editor.
class NoteReaderScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const NoteReaderScreen({super.key, required this.item});
  final BookmarkModel item;

  @override
  State<NoteReaderScreen> createState() => _NoteReaderScreenState();
}

class _NoteReaderScreenState extends State<NoteReaderScreen> {
  late BookmarkModel _item = widget.item;

  Future<void> _edit() async {
    final updated = await NoteEditorSheet.show(context, item: _item);
    if (updated != null && mounted) setState(() => _item = updated);
  }

  Future<void> _delete() async {
    final remove = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text(AppCopy.deleteNoteTitle),
        content: const Text(AppCopy.deleteNoteDesc),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
              child: const Text(AppCopy.cancel)),
          FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
              child: const Text(AppCopy.delete)),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (remove != true) return;
    await BookmarkService().deleteBookmark(_item.id);
    if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context, true);
  }

  void _copy() {
    Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: noteClipboardText(_item)));
    AppSnackBar.success(context, AppCopy.noteContentCopied);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = OTColors.canvas(isDark);
    final primary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final secondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final subtle = OTColors.surfaceSubtle(isDark);
    final displayTitle = _item.documentKind == BookmarkDocumentKind.aiAnswer
        ? aiAnswerTitle(_item.fullAnswer, _item.agentTitle)
        : _item.title;
    final displayContent = _item.documentKind == BookmarkDocumentKind.aiAnswer
        ? readableAiAnswerMarkdown(_item.fullAnswer)
        : (_item.fullAnswer.isEmpty ? _item.arabicExcerpt : _item.fullAnswer);
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: canvas,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        title: Text(AppCopy.savedCollection,
            style: GoogleFonts.newsreader(
                color: primary, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.copy_outlined),
              tooltip: AppCopy.copyContentTooltip,
              onPressed: _copy),
          PopupMenuButton<String>(
            onSelected: (value) {
              if (value == 'edit') _edit();
              if (value == 'delete') _delete();
            },
            itemBuilder: (_) => const [
              PopupMenuItem(value: 'edit', child: Text(AppCopy.editNote)),
              PopupMenuItem(value: 'delete', child: Text(AppCopy.deleteNote)),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: SelectionArea(
          child: ListView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                OTSpacing.lg, OTSpacing.md, OTSpacing.lg, OTSpacing.xl),
            children: [
              Text(_kindLabel(_item),
                  style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                      fontSize: 11,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      color: secondary,
                      letterSpacing: .6)),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(displayTitle,
                  style: GoogleFonts.newsreader(
                      fontSize: 29,
                      height: 1.15,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      color: primary)),
              if (_item.agentTitle.isNotEmpty &&
                  _item.documentKind == BookmarkDocumentKind.aiAnswer &&
                  !displayTitle.toLowerCase().contains(_item.agentTitle
                      .replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^AI\s+', caseSensitive: false), '')
                      .toLowerCase())) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Text(
                  _item.agentTitle
                      .replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^AI\s+', caseSensitive: false), ''),
                  style: GoogleFonts.outfit(fontSize: 13, color: secondary),
                ),
              ],
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              Divider(color: secondary.withValues(alpha: .25)),
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              MarkdownBody(
                data: displayContent,
                selectable: true,
                styleSheet: MarkdownStyleSheet(
                  p: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                      fontSize: 16, height: 1.72, color: primary),
                  h1: GoogleFonts.newsreader(
                      fontSize: 25,
                      height: 1.2,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      color: primary),
                  h2: GoogleFonts.newsreader(
                      fontSize: 20,
                      height: 1.25,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      color: primary),
                  blockquote: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                      fontSize: 15,
                      height: 1.6,
                      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                      color: secondary),
                  blockquoteDecoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: subtle,
                      border:
                          Border(left: BorderSide(color: secondary, width: 3))),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _kindLabel(BookmarkModel item) => switch (item.documentKind) {
        BookmarkDocumentKind.personalNote => AppCopy.navSaved,
        BookmarkDocumentKind.aiAnswer => item.agentTitle.isNotEmpty
            ? item.agentTitle.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^AI\s+', caseSensitive: false), '')
            : (item.fieldName.isNotEmpty ? item.fieldName : AppCopy.studySpace),
        BookmarkDocumentKind.bookReference => AppCopy.bookReferenceLabel,
      };
}
```

```dart
class ProfileScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ProfileScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<ProfileScreen> createState() => _ProfileScreenState();
}

class _ProfileScreenState extends State<ProfileScreen> {
  final AuthService _authService = AuthService();
  bool _isLoggingOut = false;
  bool _isDeletingAccount = false;
  String _appVersion = '1.0.9';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadAppVersion();
  }

  Future<void> _loadAppVersion() async {
    try {
      final info = await PackageInfo.fromPlatform();
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _appVersion = '${info.version}+${info.buildNumber}');
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _logout() async {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);

    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) {
        return AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: surface,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: OTRadius.dialogBorder),
          title: Text(
            AppCopy.logoutDialogTitle,
            style: OTTypography.cardTitle(color: textPrimary)
                .copyWith(fontSize: 18),
          ),
          content: Text(
            AppCopy.logoutDialogBody,
            style: OTTypography.body(color: textSecondary),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
              child: Text(AppCopy.cancel,
                  style: OTTypography.button(color: textSecondary)),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: OTColors.destructive,
                shape:
                    RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: OTRadius.buttonBorder),
              ),
              child: Text(AppCopy.logoutButton,
                  style: OTTypography.button(color: Colors.white)),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );

    if (!mounted || confirm != true) return;

    setState(() => _isLoggingOut = true);
    try {
      await _authService.signOut();
      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(
            context, AppRoutes.login, (r) => false);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoggingOut = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _deleteAccount() async {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);

    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) {
        return AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: surface,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: OTRadius.dialogBorder),
          title: Row(
            children: [
              const Icon(Icons.warning_amber_rounded,
                  color: OTColors.destructive, size: 24),
              const SizedBox(width: OTSpacing.sm),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  AppCopy.deleteAccountTitle,
                  style: OTTypography.cardTitle(color: OTColors.destructive)
                      .copyWith(fontSize: 18),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          content: Text(
            AppCopy.deleteAccountBody,
            style: OTTypography.body(color: OTColors.textSecondary(isDark)),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
              child: Text(AppCopy.cancel,
                  style: OTTypography.button(
                      color: OTColors.textSecondary(isDark))),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: OTColors.destructive,
                shape:
                    RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: OTRadius.buttonBorder),
              ),
              child: Text(AppCopy.deleteAccountButton,
                  style: OTTypography.button(color: Colors.white)),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );

    if (!mounted || confirm != true) return;

    setState(() => _isDeletingAccount = true);
    try {
      await _authService.deleteAccount();
      if (mounted) {
        AppSnackBar.success(context, AppCopy.deleteAccountSuccess);
        Navigator.pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(
            context, AppRoutes.login, (r) => false);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isDeletingAccount = false);
        final errText = e.toString().contains('requires-recent-login')
            ? AppCopy.recentLoginRequired
            : AppCopy.networkError;
        AppSnackBar.error(context, errText);
      }
    }
  }

  void _openSubscription([UserModel? userModel]) {
    final user = userModel ?? _authService.cachedCurrentUser;
    NavigationGuard.safePushNamed(
      context,
      AppRoutes.subscription,
      arguments: {
        'user': user,
        'agent': AgentModel.defaultAgents.firstWhere(
          (a) => a.id == 'fiqh_tahawwulat',
          orElse: () => AgentModel.defaultAgents.first,
        ),
      },
    );
  }

  void _showAccessPortfolio(UserModel? user, MembershipPassSummary summary) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final entries = (user?.entitlements.entries ?? const <MapEntry<String, ModuleEntitlement>>[])
        .where((entry) => summary.agentIds.contains(entry.key))
        .toList();
    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 14, 20, 28),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: surface,
          borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
        ),
        child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
          Center(child: Container(width: 36, height: 4, decoration: BoxDecoration(color: textSecondary.withValues(alpha: .35), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99)))),
          const SizedBox(height: 18),
          Text('Rincian akses Pro', style: OTTypography.cardTitle(color: textPrimary).copyWith(fontSize: 19)),
          const SizedBox(height: 5),
          Text('Akses yang aktif di akun ini.', style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary)),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          if (summary.agentIds.contains('all_access') || summary.agentIds.contains('all_ai'))
            _AccessPortfolioRow(title: 'Seluruh asisten OpenTurath', subtitle: summary.supportingLabel, color: textPrimary, muted: textSecondary)
          else
            ...entries.map((entry) => _AccessPortfolioRow(
              title: _entitlementTitle(entry.key),
              subtitle: entry.value.expiry == null ? 'Akses aktif' : 'Berakhir ${_formatAccessDate(entry.value.expiry!)}',
              color: textPrimary,
              muted: textSecondary,
            )),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  static String _formatAccessDate(DateTime value) {
    const months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'Mei', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Agu', 'Sep', 'Okt', 'Nov', 'Des'];
    return '${value.day} ${months[value.month - 1]} ${value.year}';
  }

  static String _entitlementTitle(String key) => switch (key) {
        'fiqh_tahawwulat' => 'AI Fikih Tahawwulat',
        'fiqh_syafii' => "AI Fikih Syafi'i",
        'nahwu' => 'AI Bahasa Arab',
        'ushul_fiqh' => 'AI Usul Fikih',
        'tafsir' => 'AI Tafsir',
        'hadits' => 'AI Hadis',
        'aqidah' => 'AI Akidah',
        _ => 'Asisten kajian',
      };

  Widget _buildThemeOption({
    required String title,
    required IconData icon,
    required bool isSelected,
    required bool isDark,
    required Color textPrimary,
    required Color textSecondary,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    final activeBg = isDark ? const Color(0xFF18181B) : Colors.white;
    final activeFg = isDark ? Colors.white : const Color(0xFF18181B);
    final inactiveFg = textSecondary;

    return Expanded(
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: () {
          HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
          onTap();
        },
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isSelected ? activeBg : Colors.transparent,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),
            boxShadow: isSelected
                ? [
                    BoxShadow(
                      color:
                          Colors.black.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.35 : 0.06),
                      blurRadius: 4,
                      offset: const Offset(0, 1),
                    ),
                  ]
                : null,
          ),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Icon(icon, size: 15, color: isSelected ? activeFg : inactiveFg),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Text(
                title,
                style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.w500,
                  color: isSelected ? activeFg : inactiveFg,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Kartu akses anggota: merangkum identitas, status, dan ruang AI yang dapat
/// dipakai tanpa menyamarkan halaman pengaturan sebagai layar perbankan.
class _MembershipPass extends StatelessWidget {
  final String holderName;
  final String email;
  final MembershipPassSummary summary;
  final bool isDark;
  final VoidCallback onManage;
  final VoidCallback? onViewAccess;

  const _MembershipPass({
    required this.holderName,
    required this.email,
    required this.summary,
    required this.isDark,
    required this.onManage,
    this.onViewAccess,
  });

  String _expiryLabel() {
    if (summary.expiresAt == null) return '—';
    const shortMonths = [
      'JAN',
      'FEB',
      'MAR',
      'APR',
      'MEI',
      'JUN',
      'JUL',
      'AGU',
      'SEP',
      'OKT',
      'NOV',
      'DES',
    ];
    return '${summary.expiresAt!.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} ${shortMonths[summary.expiresAt!.month - 1]} ${summary.expiresAt!.year}';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cardStart =
        isDark ? const Color(0xFF303036) : const Color(0xFF25252A);
    final cardEnd = isDark ? const Color(0xFF17171A) : const Color(0xFF111114);
    const foreground = Color(0xFFF8F8F8);
    const muted = Color(0xFFC7C7CC);
    final isOpen = summary.isOpen;

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        Semantics(
          button: true,
          label:
              'Kartu akses OpenTurath. ${summary.badge}. ${summary.accessLabel}',
          child: Material(
            color: Colors.transparent,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
            child: InkWell(
              onTap: onViewAccess ?? onManage,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
              child: Ink(
                height: 206,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                    begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                    end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                    colors: [cardStart, cardEnd],
                  ),
                  border:
                      Border.all(color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.15)),
                  boxShadow: [
                    BoxShadow(
                      color:
                          Colors.black.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.26 : 0.18),
                      blurRadius: 22,
                      offset: const Offset(0, 10),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                child: ClipRRect(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(23),
                  child: Stack(
                    children: [
                      // Ornamen geometris halus: memberi karakter tanpa
                      // menyamai visual kartu bank atau mengganggu teks.
                      Positioned(
                        right: -52,
                        top: -76,
                        child: Container(
                          width: 190,
                          height: 190,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            border: Border.all(
                              color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                              width: 1.2,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      Positioned(
                        right: 20,
                        top: 30,
                        child: Container(
                          width: 74,
                          height: 74,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
                            border: Border.all(
                              color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      Positioned(
                        left: -36,
                        bottom: -56,
                        child: Container(
                          width: 150,
                          height: 150,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.035),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 18, 20, 16),
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            Row(
                              children: [
                                Text(
                                  'OpenTurath',
                                  style: GoogleFonts.newsreader(
                                    color: foreground,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                    fontSize: 21,
                                    letterSpacing: -0.4,
                                  ),
                                ),
                                const Spacer(),
                                Container(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                      horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: isOpen
                                        ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.16)
                                        : Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
                                    border: Border.all(
                                        color: Colors.white
```

```dart
class _SpecialistListScreenState extends State<SpecialistListScreen> {
  final AgentService _agentService = AgentService();
  final AuthService _authService = AuthService();
  final TextEditingController _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();
  Timer? _debounce;

  List<AgentModel> _allAgents = [];
  String? _selectedFieldId;
  String _searchQuery = '';
  bool _isLoading = true;
  CorpusKind _corpusKind = CorpusKind.discipline;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _selectedFieldId = widget.field?.id;
    _loadAgents();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    _debounce?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadAgents() async {
    try {
      final agents = await _agentService.getAgents();
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _allAgents = agents;
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _allAgents = AgentModel.defaultAgents;
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  void _onSearchChanged(String val) {
    if (_debounce?.isActive ?? false) _debounce!.cancel();
    _debounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 250), () {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _searchQuery = val.trim();
        });
      }
    });
  }

  List<AgentModel> _computeFilteredAgents() {
    return _allAgents.where((agent) {
      // 1. Filter by CorpusKind
      if (agent.kind != _corpusKind) return false;

      // 2. Filter by discipline field if in discipline mode
      if (_corpusKind == CorpusKind.discipline) {
        final matchesField = _selectedFieldId == null ||
            _selectedFieldId == 'all' ||
            agent.fieldId == _selectedFieldId;
        if (!matchesField) return false;
      }

      // 3. Filter by search query
      if (_searchQuery.isEmpty) return true;

      return ArabicUtils.matches(agent.title, _searchQuery) ||
          ArabicUtils.matches(agent.titleArabic, _searchQuery) ||
          ArabicUtils.matches(agent.subtitleAcademic, _searchQuery) ||
          ArabicUtils.matches(agent.description, _searchQuery);
    }).toList();
  }

  void _openAgent(AgentModel agent) {
    OTMotion.light();
    if (agent.isComingSoon) {
      AppSnackBar.warning(
        context,
        AppCopy.preparingModule(agent.title),
      );
      return;
    }

    final user = _authService.cachedCurrentUser;
    if (user == null || !user.hasAccessToAgent(agent.id)) {
      _openSubscriptionForAgent(agent, user: user);
      return;
    }

    AgentSessionManager.instance.openAgent(agent, user: user);
  }

  void _openTahawwulatSubAgent(AgentModel parentAgent, SubAgentModel subAgent) {
    OTMotion.light();
    final user = _authService.cachedCurrentUser;
    if (user == null || !user.hasAccessToAgent(parentAgent.id)) {
      _openSubscriptionForAgent(parentAgent, user: user);
      return;
    }

    final personaAgent = AgentModel(
      id: subAgent.id,
      title: 'Fikih Tahawwulat: ${subAgent.name}',
      titleArabic: subAgent.nameArabic,
      description: subAgent.description,
      emoji: subAgent.emoji,
      category: parentAgent.category,
      status: 'active',
      sortOrder: parentAgent.sortOrder,
      fieldId: parentAgent.fieldId,
      subtitleAcademic: subAgent.description,
      suggestedPrompts: parentAgent.suggestedPrompts,
      referenceBooks: parentAgent.referenceBooks,
      catalogId: parentAgent.catalogId,
      kind: parentAgent.kind,
      disciplineIds: parentAgent.disciplineIds,
      scholarIds: parentAgent.scholarIds,
    );

    AgentSessionManager.instance.openAgent(personaAgent, user: user);
  }

  void _openSubscriptionForAgent(AgentModel agent, {UserModel? user}) {
    final targetUser = user ?? _authService.cachedCurrentUser;
    NavigationGuard.safePushNamed(
      context,
      AppRoutes.subscription,
      arguments: {'agent': agent, 'user': targetUser},
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = OTColors.canvas(isDark);
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);

    final isGeneralTab = widget.field == null;
    final title = isGeneralTab ? AppCopy.navStudies : widget.field!.name;
    final filtered = _computeFilteredAgents();
    final shell = MainShellController.of(context);

    return PopScope(
      canPop: isGeneralTab && (shell == null || !Navigator.canPop(context)),
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, result) {
        if (didPop) return;
        if (!isGeneralTab) {
          if (shell != null) {
            shell.switchTab(0);
          } else if (Navigator.canPop(context)) {
            Navigator.pop(context);
          }
        } else if (Navigator.canPop(context)) {
          Navigator.pop(context);
        }
      },
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: Text(
            title,
            style: OTTypography.corpusTitle(color: textPrimary).copyWith(fontSize: 20),
          ),
          centerTitle: false,
          backgroundColor: canvas,
          elevation: 0,
          scrolledUnderElevation: 0,
          leading: isGeneralTab
              ? null
              : IconButton(
                  icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded, color: textPrimary),
                  onPressed: () {
                    final shell = MainShellController.of(context);
                    if (shell != null) {
                      shell.switchTab(0);
                    } else if (Navigator.canPop(context)) {
                      Navigator.pop(context);
                    }
                  },
                ),
        ),
      body: SafeArea(
        top: false,

  Widget _filterChip({
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../core/routes.dart';
import '../core/theme.dart';
import '../widgets/app_loader.dart';

class SplashScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SplashScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<SplashScreen> createState() => _SplashScreenState();
}

class _SplashScreenState extends State<SplashScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _controller;
  late Animation<double> _fadeAnimation;
  late Animation<double> _scaleAnimation;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    _controller = AnimationController(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 450),
      vsync: this,
    );

    _fadeAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _controller, curve: Curves.easeOut),
    );

    _scaleAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 0.95, end: 1.0).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _controller, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic),
    );

    _controller.forward();
    _checkAuthAndNavigate();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _checkAuthAndNavigate() async {
    try {
      final user = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
      String targetRoute;

      if (user != null && !user.isAnonymous) {
        final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance()
            .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 3));
        final isSessionReady = prefs.getBool('google_session_ready') ?? false;
        if (!isSessionReady) {
          targetRoute = AppRoutes.googleSessionAuth;
        } else {
          targetRoute = AppRoutes.dashboard;
        }
      } else {
        targetRoute = AppRoutes.login;
      }

      if (!mounted) return;
      Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, targetRoute);
    } catch (_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, AppRoutes.login);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const bg = AppTheme.canvasDark;
    const textPrimary = AppTheme.textPrimaryDark;
    const accent = AppTheme.textSecondaryDark;

    return AnnotatedRegion<SystemUiOverlayStyle>(
      value: const SystemUiOverlayStyle(
        statusBarColor: Colors.transparent,
        statusBarIconBrightness: Brightness.light,
        systemNavigationBarColor: bg,
        systemNavigationBarIconBrightness: Brightness.light,
      ),
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: bg,
        body: Center(
          child: FadeTransition(
            opacity: _fadeAnimation,
            child: ScaleTransition(
              scale: _scaleAnimation,
              child: Column(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    'OpenTurath',
                    style: GoogleFonts.newsreader(
                      fontSize: 32,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      letterSpacing: -0.6,
                      color: textPrimary,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 28),
                  const AppLoader(color: accent, dotSize: 7, spacing: 3.5),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
  AgentModel? _agent;
  bool _isProcessing = false;
  bool _isSyncingGoAkal = false;

  // Durasi terpisah untuk masing-masing kartu
  int _selectedSegment = 0; // 0: 6 Paket Tematik (Launch Promo), 1: AI Satuan Spesifik
  final Map<String, int> _bundleDurationIndices = {};
  int _tahawwulatDurationIndex = 0; // 0: 1 Bulan, 1: 6 Bulan, 2: 1 Tahun
  int _otherDurationIndex = 0;      // 0: 1 Bulan, 1: 6 Bulan, 2: 1 Tahun
  AgentModel? _selectedOtherAgent;

  AgentModel get _tahawwulatAgent => AgentModel.defaultAgents.firstWhere(
        (a) => a.id == 'fiqh_tahawwulat',
        orElse: () => AgentModel.defaultAgents.first,
      );

  List<AgentModel> get _otherAgents => AgentModel.defaultAgents
      .where((a) => a.isActive && a.id != 'fiqh_tahawwulat')
      .toList();

  // Tier untuk disiplin ilmu lainnya berbasis GoAkal Registry Otomatis
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _getOtherTiers(AgentModel? agent) {
    return GoAkalCatalogRegistry.getTiersForAgent(agent?.id);
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    if (_user == null) {
      final args = ModalRoute.of(context)?.settings.arguments;
      if (args is UserModel) {
        _user = args;
      } else if (args is Map<String, dynamic>) {
        _user = args['user'] as UserModel?;
        _agent = args['agent'] as AgentModel?;
      }

      final fbUser = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
      if (_user == null && fbUser != null) {
        _user = UserModel(
          uid: fbUser.uid,
          email: fbUser.email ?? '',
          name: fbUser.displayName ??
              (fbUser.email?.split('@').first ?? 'Santri Peneliti'),
          photoUrl: fbUser.photoURL ?? '',
          plan: 'trial',
          questionsUsed: 0,
        );
      }

      final others = _otherAgents;
      if (_selectedOtherAgent == null && others.isNotEmpty) {
        if (_agent != null && _agent!.id != 'fiqh_tahawwulat') {
          _selectedOtherAgent = others.firstWhere(
            (a) => a.id == _agent!.id,
            orElse: () => others.first,
          );
        } else {
          _selectedOtherAgent = others.firstWhere(
            (a) => a.id == 'fiqh_syafii',
            orElse: () => others.first,
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  Future<String?> _getOrPromptPhone() async {
    final uid = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid;
    if (uid == null) return null;
    final phoneKey = 'openturath_${uid}_user_phone';
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final saved = prefs.getString(phoneKey) ?? '';
      if (saved.isNotEmpty && saved.length >= 8) {
        return saved;
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    if (!mounted) return null;
    final textController = TextEditingController();
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);

    String? phone;
    try {
      phone = await showDialog<String>(
        context: context,
        barrierDismissible: false,
        builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: surface,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: OTRadius.dialogBorder,
            side: BorderSide(color: border, width: 0.8),
          ),
          title: Text(
            'Nomor WhatsApp',
            style:
                OTTypography.cardTitle(color: textPrimary).copyWith(fontSize: 17),
          ),
          content: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(
                'Masukkan nomor WhatsApp aktif untuk konfirmasi pembayaran dan aktivasi langganan.',
                style:
                    OTTypography.body(color: textSecondary).copyWith(fontSize: 13),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.base),
              TextField(
                controller: textController,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.phone,
                autofocus: true,
                style: OTTypography.body(color: textPrimary),
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  hintText: 'Contoh: 081234567890',
                  hintStyle: OTTypography.body(color: textSecondary),
                  prefixIcon:
                      const Icon(Icons.phone_iphone_rounded, size: 20),
                  contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                      horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(
                    borderRadius: OTRadius.inputBorder,
                    borderSide: BorderSide(color: border),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () {
                OTMotion.light();
                Navigator.pop(ctx, null);
              },
              child:
                  Text('Batal', style: OTTypography.button(color: textSecondary)),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: () {
                final val = textController.text.trim();
                if (val.length < 8) {
                  AppSnackBar.warning(ctx, 'Masukkan nomor telepon yang valid.');
                  return;
                }
                OTMotion.success();
                Navigator.pop(ctx, val);
              },
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: textPrimary,
                foregroundColor:
                    isDark ? const Color(0xFF18181B) : Colors.white,
                shape:
                    RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: OTRadius.buttonBorder),
              ),
              child: Text('Lanjutkan pembayaran', style: OTTypography.button()),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      textController.dispose();
    }

    if (phone != null && phone.isNotEmpty) {
      try {
        final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
        await prefs.setString(phoneKey, phone);
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    return phone;
  }

  Future<void> _syncAkalPurchases({bool isSilent = false}) async {
    if (_isSyncingGoAkal) return;
    final fbUser = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    if (fbUser == null) {
      if (!isSilent && mounted) {
        AppSnackBar.warning(
          context,
          'Silakan masuk akun terlebih dahulu untuk menyinkronkan data langganan.',
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isSyncingGoAkal = true);
    if (!isSilent && mounted) {
      AppSnackBar.info(
        context,
        'Menyinkronkan transaksi GoAkal dengan akun Google Anda...',
      );
    }

    try {
      final res = await _subService.syncAkalPurchases();
      final success = res['success'] == true;
      final syncedList = (res['synced'] as List<dynamic>?)?.cast<String>() ?? [];
      final message = res['message'] as String? ?? '';

      if (!mounted) return;

      if (success && syncedList.isNotEmpty) {
        AppSnackBar.success(
          context,
          'Alhamdulillah! Akses aktif berhasil disinkronkan: ${syncedList.join(", ")}.',
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
        );
        setState(() {});
      } else if (!isSilent) {
        AppSnackBar.info(
          context,
          message.isNotEmpty
              ? message
              : 'Belum ditemukan transaksi aktif baru di GoAkal untuk email ini.',
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
        );
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (!isSilent && mounted) {
        AppSnackBar.error(
          context,
          'Kendala saat menghubungi server GoAkal. Periksa koneksi internet Anda.',
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isSyncingGoAkal = false);
    }
  }

  String _formatRupiah(int amount) {
    final str = amount.toString();
    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = str.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      buffer.write(str[i]);
      count++;
      if (count % 3 == 0 && i > 0) {
        buffer.write('.');
      }
    }
    return buffer.toString().split('').reversed.join('');
  }

  Future<void> _handleBundleCheckout({
    required ThematicBundleMeta bundle,
    required int durationIndex,
  }) async {
    final tiers = bundle.tiers;
    if (tiers.isEmpty) return;
    final safeIdx = durationIndex < tiers.length ? durationIndex : 0;
    final tier = tiers[safeIdx];
    final paymentUrl = tier.applyUrl.isNotEmpty
        ? tier.applyUrl
        : GoAkalCatalogRegistry.storeUrl;
    final planTitle = '${bundle.title} (${tier.title})';

    await DokuCheckoutSheet.show(
      context,
      paymentUrl: paymentUrl,
      invoiceNumber: '',
      planTitle: planTitle,
      amount: tier.amount,
    );

    if (mounted) {
      await _syncAkalPurchases(isSilent: false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _handleTierCheckout({
    required Map<String, dynamic> tier,
    required AgentModel targetAgent,
  }) async {
    final rawApplyUrl = tier['applyUrl'] as String? ?? '';
    final planTitle = '${tier['name']} ${targetAgent.title}'.trim();
    final price = tier['price'] as int;

    final paymentUrl = rawApplyUrl.isNotEmpty
        ? rawApplyUrl
        : 'https://goakal.com/openturath-ai';

    // Buka pop-up modal checkout in-app resmi GoAkal tanpa keluar aplikasi
    await DokuCheckoutSheet.show(
      context,
      paymentUrl: paymentUrl,
      invoiceNumber: '',
      planTitle: planTitle,
      amount: price,
    );

    // Otomatis sinkronkan status pembelian GoAkal begitu lembar transaksi ditutup
    if (mounted) {
      await _syncAkalPurchases(isSilent: false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _handleSubscribe({
    required String plan,
    required String planTitle,
    required int price,
    AgentModel? targetAgent,
  }) async {
    final fbUser = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    if (_user == null && fbUser != null) {
      _user = UserModel(
        uid: fbUser.uid,
        email: fbUser.email ?? '',
        name: fbUser.displayName ?? 'Santri Peneliti',
        photoUrl: fbUser.photoURL ?? '',
        plan: 'trial',
        questionsUsed: 0,
      );
    }

    if (_user == null) {
      AppSnackBar.warning(
        context,
        'Silakan masuk akun terlebih dahulu untuk berlangganan.',
      );
      return;
    }

    final phone = await _getOrPromptPhone();
    if (phone == null || phone.isEmpty) return;

    final currentAgent = targetAgent ?? _agent;

    setState(() {
      _isProcessing = true;
    });

    String? dokuUrl;
    String invoiceNumber = '';
    String trxId = '';

    try {
      final userName = _user!.name.trim().isNotEmpty
          ? _user!.name.trim()
          : (_user!.email.isNotEmpty
              ? _user!.email.split('@').first
              : 'Santri Peneliti');

      final result = await _subService
          .createPayment(
            uid: _user!.uid,
            agentId: currentAgent?.id ?? 'all_ai',
            plan: plan,
            planTitle: planTitle,
            amount: price,
            name: userName,
            email: _user!.email,
            phone: phone,
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 20));

      final redirectUrl = result['redirectUrl'] as String?;
      invoiceNumber = (result['invoiceNumber'] as String?) ?? '';
      trxId = (result['trxId'] as String?) ?? '';
      if (redirectUrl != null && redirectUrl.isNotEmpty) {
        dokuUrl = redirectUrl;
      } else {
        throw Exception('DOKU PG tidak mengembalikan URL pembayaran valid');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      AppSnackBar.error(
        context,
        'Terjadi kendala saat menyiapkan sesi pembayaran. Periksa koneksi internet Anda lalu coba kembali.',
      );
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isProcessing = false);
      return;
    }

    try {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final isPaid = await DokuCheckoutSheet.show(
        context,
        paymentUrl: dokuUrl,
        invoiceNumber: invoiceNumber,
        trxId: trxId,
        planTitle: planTitle,
        amount: price,
      );

      if (isPaid == true) {
        if (!mounted) return;
        AppSnackBar.success(
          context,
          'Pembayaran berhasil. Akses sudah aktif.',
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
        );
        Navigator.pop(context);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      AppSnackBar.error(
        context,
        'Tidak dapat membuka sesi pembayaran saat ini. Silakan coba kembali.',
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isProcessing = false);
    }
  }
```

```dart
import 'package:cloud_functions/cloud_functions.dart';
import '../models/agent_model.dart';
import '../core/constants.dart';

class AgentService {
  final FirebaseFunctions _functions = FirebaseFunctions.instance;

  // ── Ambil daftar semua agent dari Firestore / model lokal ────
  Future<List<AgentModel>> getAgents() async {
    return AgentModel.defaultAgents;
  }

  // ── Ambil URL agent dari Cloud Function secara aman (Server-Side Entitlement) ────
  Future<String?> getAgentUrl(String agentId) async {
    try {
      final callable = _functions.httpsCallable(AppConstants.fnGetAgentUrl);
      final result = await callable.call({'agentId': agentId});
      final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(result.data);
      final url = data['url'] as String?;
      if (url != null && url.isNotEmpty) {
        return url;
      }
      throw const AgentAccessException('empty-url', 'URL asisten belum tersedia untuk bidang ini.');
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      if (e.code == 'permission-denied') {
        throw AgentAccessException(
          'permission-denied',
          e.message ?? 'Langganan diperlukan untuk membuka asisten ini.',
        );
      }
      throw AgentAccessException(e.code, e.message ?? 'Tidak dapat terhubung ke server.');
    } catch (e) {
      if (e is AgentAccessException) rethrow;
      throw AgentAccessException('unknown-error', e.toString());
    }
  }

  // ── Catat pertanyaan trial secara atomik di Cloud Functions ───
  Future<TrialUsage> recordQuestion(String agentId) async {
    try {
      final callable = _functions.httpsCallable('recordQuestion');
      final result = await callable.call({'agentId': agentId});
      final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(result.data);
      return TrialUsage(
        isPremium: data['isPremium'] == true,
        questionsUsed: (data['questionsUsed'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
        questionsRemaining: (data['questionsRemaining'] as num?)?.toInt(),
      );
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      throw AgentAccessException(e.code, e.message ?? 'Gagal mencatat kuota pertanyaan.');
    } catch (e) {
      if (e is AgentAccessException) rethrow;
      throw AgentAccessException('record-error', e.toString());
    }
  }
}

class TrialUsage {
  const TrialUsage({
    required this.isPremium,
    required this.questionsUsed,
    required this.questionsRemaining,
  });

  final bool isPremium;
  final int questionsUsed;
  final int? questionsRemaining;
}

class AgentAccessException implements Exception {
  const AgentAccessException(this.code, this.message);
  final String code;
  final String message;

  @override
  String toString() => 'AgentAccessException($code): $message';
}
```

### FLUTTER FILE: openturath_ai/lib/services/agent_session_manager.dart
```dart
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter_inappwebview/flutter_inappwebview.dart';
import '../models/agent_model.dart';
import '../models/user_model.dart';

/// Represents a single active AI specialist tab in memory.
class AgentSessionTab {
  final AgentModel agent;
  String? resolvedUrl;
  InAppWebViewController? webController;
  final InAppWebViewKeepAlive keepAlive = InAppWebViewKeepAlive();
  bool isUrlLoading = true;
  bool isWebLoading = true;
  bool isSessionReady = false;
  String? errorMessage;
  bool isPaywallRequired = false;
  bool isTimeoutError = false;
  bool isGooglePermissionError = false;
  double fontScale = 1.0;
  bool hasAcknowledgedAdab = false;

  AgentSessionTab({
    required this.agent,
    this.resolvedUrl,
  });
}

/// AgentSessionManager: Singleton state manager for multi-tab AI study sessions.
/// Keeps up to 7 specialists loaded in background memory like Google Chrome tabs.
class AgentSessionManager extends ChangeNotifier {
  static final AgentSessionManager instance = AgentSessionManager._();
  AgentSessionManager._();

  static const int maxTabs = 3;

  final List<AgentSessionTab> _tabs = [];
  int _activeIndex = 0;
  bool _isOpen = false;

  List<AgentSessionTab> get tabs => List.unmodifiable(_tabs);
  int get activeIndex => _activeIndex;
  bool get isOpen => _isOpen;
  bool get hasSessions => _tabs.isNotEmpty;

  AgentSessionTab? get activeTab {
    if (_tabs.isEmpty || _activeIndex < 0 || _activeIndex >= _tabs.length) {
      return null;
    }
    return _tabs[_activeIndex];
  }

  /// Open an agent or switch to its existing active tab with zero reload.
  void openAgent(AgentModel agent, {UserModel? user}) {
    final existingIndex = _tabs.indexWhere((t) => t.agent.id == agent.id);
    if (existingIndex != -1) {
      _activeIndex = existingIndex;
    } else {
      if (_tabs.length >= maxTabs) {
        // Tab limit reached: close oldest non-active tab to preserve WebView memory
        final evictIndex = _activeIndex == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        closeTab(evictIndex);
      }
      _tabs.add(AgentSessionTab(agent: agent));
      _activeIndex = _tabs.length - 1;
    }
    _isOpen = true;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Switch active tab (like clicking a Chrome tab).
  void selectTab(int index) {
    if (index >= 0 && index < _tabs.length && _activeIndex != index) {
      _activeIndex = index;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  /// Close a specific tab with the 'x' button.
  void closeTab(int index) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= _tabs.length) return;

    try {
      _tabs[index].webController?.stopLoading();
    } catch (_) {}

    _tabs.removeAt(index);

    if (_tabs.isEmpty) {
      _isOpen = false;
      _activeIndex = 0;
    } else if (index < _activeIndex) {
      _activeIndex--;
    } else if (_activeIndex >= _tabs.length) {
      _activeIndex = _tabs.length - 1;
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Hide the AI study room to return to the Dashboard while keeping all WebViews alive.
  void closeRoom() {
    _isOpen = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Reset all sessions (e.g. on user logout).
  void closeAll() {
    for (final tab in _tabs) {
      try {
        tab.webController?.stopLoading();
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    _tabs.clear();
    _activeIndex = 0;
    _isOpen = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}
```
