### FLUTTER FILE: openturath_ai/lib/widgets/update_ready_banner.dart
```dart
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
import '../core/theme.dart';
import '../services/update_service.dart';

class UpdateReadyBanner extends StatelessWidget {
  const UpdateReadyBanner({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final updateService = UpdateService();

    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: updateService,
      builder: (context, _) {
        if (!updateService.isUpdateReady) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }

        final isDesktop = !kIsWeb && !Platform.isAndroid && !Platform.isIOS;
        final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
        final surface = isDark ? AppTheme.surfaceCardDark : AppTheme.surfaceCardLight;
        final border = isDark ? AppTheme.borderDark : AppTheme.borderLight;
        final textPrimary = isDark ? AppTheme.textPrimaryDark : AppTheme.textPrimaryLight;
        final textSecondary = isDark ? AppTheme.textSecondaryDark : AppTheme.textSecondaryLight;
        final info = updateService.updateInfo;
        final version = info?.latestVersion ?? '';

        return Container(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: surface,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusCard),
            border: Border.all(
              color: border,
              width: 1,
            ),
          ),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 40,
                height: 40,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: isDark ? AppTheme.borderDark : AppTheme.pillSecondaryBgLight,
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                ),
                child: const Icon(
                  Icons.system_update_rounded,
                  color: AppTheme.appleGreen,
                  size: 20,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 14),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      isDesktop ? 'Pembaruan v$version Tersedia' : 'Pembaruan v$version Siap Dipasang',
                      style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        color: textPrimary,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      isDesktop
                          ? 'Ketuk untuk membuka tautan pembaruan versi desktop terbaru.'
                          : 'Selesai diunduh di latar belakang. Ketuk pasang untuk menerapkan.',
                      style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: textSecondary,
                      ),
                      maxLines: 2,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              FilledButton(
                onPressed: () => updateService.installNow(),
                style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: AppTheme.appleGreen,
                  foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
                  minimumSize: const Size(64, 36),
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusPill),
                  ),
                  elevation: 0,
                ),
                child: Text(
                  isDesktop ? 'Perbarui' : 'Pasang',
                  style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}
```

### TEST FILE: openturath_ai/test/active_subscription_access_test.dart
```dart
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/models/user_model.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/core/constants.dart';

void main() {
  group('Active Subscription Access Verification', () {
    final futureExpiry = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 365));
    final pastExpiry = DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(days: 1));

    test('Active subscriber with plan tholib_1m has access to all agents even with empty entitlements', () {
      final user = UserModel(
        uid: 'user_active_tholib',
        name: 'Rafli Husen',
        email: '[REDACTED_EMAIL]',
        photoUrl: '',
        plan: AppConstants.planTholib1m,
        subscriptionExpiry: futureExpiry,
        questionsUsed: 0,
        entitlements: {},
      );

      expect(user.isPremium, isTrue);
      expect(user.isSubscriptionActive, isTrue);
      expect(user.hasAccess, isTrue);
      expect(user.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_syafii'), isTrue);
      expect(user.hasAccessToAgent('hadits'), isTrue);
      expect(user.hasAccessToAgent('ushul_fiqh'), isTrue);
      expect(user.hasAccessToAgent('nahwu_sharaf'), isTrue);
    });

    test('Active subscriber with plan bahits_1y or tholib_6m has full access', () {
      for (final planName in [AppConstants.planBahits1y, AppConstants.planTholib6m, 'sultan', 'all_ai_1m', 'full']) {
        final user = UserModel(
          uid: 'user_full_$planName',
          name: 'Peneliti',
          email: 'peneliti@example.com',
          photoUrl: '',
          plan: planName,
          subscriptionExpiry: futureExpiry,
          questionsUsed: 0,
          entitlements: {},
        );

        expect(user.isSubscriptionActive, isTrue, reason: planName);
        expect(user.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_syafii'), isTrue, reason: planName);
        expect(user.hasAccessToAgent('tafsir'), isTrue, reason: planName);
      }
    });

  test('Active subscriber with redeem voucher code has full access', () {
      final user = UserModel(
        uid: 'user_redeem',
        name: 'Santri',
        email: 'santri@example.com',
        photoUrl: '',
        plan: 'redeem_1y',
        subscriptionExpiry: futureExpiry,
        questionsUsed: 0,
        entitlements: {},
      );

      expect(user.isSubscriptionActive, isTrue);
      expect(user.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_syafii'), isTrue);
    });

    test('Expired subscriber is denied access', () {
      final user = UserModel(
        uid: 'user_expired',
        name: 'Expired User',
        email: 'expired@example.com',
        photoUrl: '',
        plan: AppConstants.planTholib1m,
        subscriptionExpiry: pastExpiry,
        questionsUsed: 0,
        entitlements: {},
      );

      expect(user.isSubscriptionActive, isFalse);
      expect(user.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_syafii'), isFalse);
    });

    test('Single-module subscriber only has access to entitled module', () {
      final user = UserModel(
        uid: 'user_single',
        name: 'Single User',
        email: 'single@example.com',
        photoUrl: '',
        plan: 'single',
        subscriptionExpiry: futureExpiry,
        questionsUsed: 0,
        entitlements: {
          'fiqh_syafii': ModuleEntitlement(
            plan: 'single',
            expiry: futureExpiry,
            status: 'active',
          ),
        },
      );

      expect(user.isSubscriptionActive, isTrue);
      expect(user.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_syafii'), isTrue);
      expect(user.hasAccessToAgent('hadits'), isFalse);
    });
  });

  test('time-bound trial voucher grants access without a question quota', () {
    final user = UserModel(
      uid: 'trial-user',
      name: 'Trial',
      email: 'trial@example.test',
      photoUrl: '',
      plan: 'trial',
      questionsUsed: 999,
      entitlements: {
        'all_access': ModuleEntitlement(
          plan: 'trial',
          expiry: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 7)),
        ),
      },
    );

    expect(user.hasAccessToAgent('fikih-syafii'), isTrue);
    expect(user.questionsRemainingForAgent('fikih-syafii'), 9999);
  });
}
```

### TEST FILE: openturath_ai/test/agent_session_manager_test.dart
```dart
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/models/agent_model.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/services/agent_session_manager.dart';

void main() {
  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  final agentSyafii = AgentModel.defaultAgents.firstWhere((a) => a.id == 'fiqh_syafii');
  final agentHanafi = AgentModel.defaultAgents.firstWhere((a) => a.id == 'fiqh_hanafi');
  final agentMaliki = AgentModel.defaultAgents.firstWhere((a) => a.id == 'fiqh_maliki');

  setUp(() {
    AgentSessionManager.instance.closeAll();
  });

  tearDown(() {
    AgentSessionManager.instance.closeAll();
  });

  group('AgentSessionManager Multi-Tab Keep-Alive Suite', () {
    test('Starts empty and closed', () {
      final manager = AgentSessionManager.instance;
      expect(manager.tabs.isEmpty, isTrue);
      expect(manager.isOpen, isFalse);
      expect(manager.activeTab, isNull);
    });

    test('Opening an agent adds a tab and opens the room', () {
      final manager = AgentSessionManager.instance;
      manager.openAgent(agentSyafii);

      expect(manager.tabs.length, 1);
      expect(manager.isOpen, isTrue);
      expect(manager.activeIndex, 0);
      expect(manager.activeTab?.agent.id, 'fiqh_syafii');
    });

    test('Opening same agent twice switches to existing tab without reload or duplication', () {
      final manager = AgentSessionManager.instance;
      manager.openAgent(agentSyafii);
      manager.openAgent(agentHanafi);

      expect(manager.tabs.length, 2);
      expect(manager.activeIndex, 1);
      expect(manager.activeTab?.agent.id, 'fiqh_hanafi');

      // Open syafii again
      manager.openAgent(agentSyafii);

      // Should switch back to tab 0 without adding a 3rd tab
      expect(manager.tabs.length, 2);
      expect(manager.activeIndex, 0);
      expect(manager.activeTab?.agent.id, 'fiqh_syafii');
    });

    test('closeRoom() hides the room while preserving active tabs in background', () {
      final manager = AgentSessionManager.instance;
      manager.openAgent(agentSyafii);
      manager.openAgent(agentMaliki);

      expect(manager.isOpen, isTrue);
      expect(manager.tabs.length, 2);

      // User presses back to return to dashboard
      manager.closeRoom();

      // Room is hidden, but tabs and WebViews remain completely alive in memory
      expect(manager.isOpen, isFalse);
      expect(manager.tabs.length, 2);
      expect(manager.tabs[0].agent.id, 'fiqh_syafii');
      expect(manager.tabs[1].agent.id, 'fiqh_maliki');

      // User clicks Maliki again from dashboard: opens instantly with zero loading
      manager.openAgent(agentMaliki);
      expect(manager.isOpen, isTrue);
      expect(manager.activeIndex, 1);
    });

    test('Closing a tab via closeTab() adjusts activeIndex correctly', () {
      final manager = AgentSessionManager.instance;
      manager.openAgent(agentSyafii);
      manager.openAgent(agentHanafi);
      manager.openAgent(agentMaliki);

      expect(manager.tabs.length, 3);
      expect(manager.activeIndex, 2); // on Maliki

      // Close Hanafi (index 1)
      manager.closeTab(1);

      expect(manager.tabs.length, 2);
      expect(manager.tabs[0].agent.id, 'fiqh_syafii');
      expect(manager.tabs[1].agent.id, 'fiqh_maliki');
      expect(manager.activeIndex, 1);

      // Close remaining tabs
      manager.closeTab(1);
      expect(manager.tabs.length, 1);
      expect(manager.activeIndex, 0);

      manager.closeTab(0);
      expect(manager.tabs.isEmpty, isTrue);
      expect(manager.isOpen, isFalse);
    });

    test('closeAll() completely clears sessions and resets state on sign out', () {
      final manager = AgentSessionManager.instance;
      manager.openAgent(agentSyafii);
      manager.openAgent(agentHanafi);

      manager.closeAll();

      expect(manager.tabs.isEmpty, isTrue);
      expect(manager.isOpen, isFalse);
      expect(manager.activeIndex, 0);
    });

    test('Closing a tab to the left of activeIndex preserves the current active tab', () {
      final manager = AgentSessionManager.instance;
      // Urutan tab: [0: Syafii, 1: Hanafi, 2: Maliki]
      manager.openAgent(agentSyafii);
      manager.openAgent(agentHanafi);
      manager.openAgent(agentMaliki);

      // Aktifkan tab Maliki (index 2)
      expect(manager.activeIndex, 2);
      expect(manager.activeTab?.agent.id, 'fiqh_maliki');

      // Tutup tab Syafii (index 0 < activeIndex 2)
      manager.closeTab(0);

      // Tab tersisa: [0: Hanafi, 1: Maliki]
      expect(manager.tabs.length, 2);
      expect(manager.activeIndex, 1);
      expect(manager.activeTab?.agent.id, 'fiqh_maliki');
    });

    test('Enforces maxTabs = 7 limit and evicts oldest non-active tab', () {
      final manager = AgentSessionManager.instance;
      final agents = AgentModel.defaultAgents;
      expect(agents.length, greaterThanOrEqualTo(8));

      // Buka 7 agen pertama
      for (int i = 0; i < AgentSessionManager.maxTabs; i++) {
        manager.openAgent(agents[i]);
      }
      expect(manager.tabs.length, AgentSessionManager.maxTabs);
      expect(manager.activeIndex, AgentSessionManager.maxTabs - 1);

      // Buka agen ke-8 (melebihi batas maxTabs 7)
      manager.openAgent(agents[7]);

      // Total tab tetap 7
      expect(manager.tabs.length, AgentSessionManager.maxTabs);
      // Tab aktif adalah agen ke-8 yang baru dibuka
      expect(manager.activeTab?.agent.id, agents[7].id);
      // Agen tertua pertama (agents[0]) telah di-evict
      expect(manager.tabs.any((t) => t.agent.id == agents[0].id), isFalse);
    });
  });
}
```

### TEST FILE: openturath_ai/test/arabic_search_normalization_test.dart
```dart
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/core/arabic_utils.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/models/book_model.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/services/canonical_library_service.dart';

void main() {
  group('Milestone 2 — Arabic Search Normalization & Scholarly Citations', () {
    test('ArabicUtils strips all diacritics and tatweel', () {
      const withTashkil = 'كِتَابُ الأُمِّ لِلإِمَامِ الشَّافِعِيِّ';
      final normalized = ArabicUtils.normalize(withTashkil);

      // Harakat removed and alif variants normalized to 'ا'
      expect(normalized, isNot(contains('\u064E'))); // Fathah
      expect(normalized, isNot(contains('\u0650'))); // Kasrah
      expect(normalized, isNot(contains('\u064F'))); // Dammah
      expect(normalized, isNot(contains('\u0651'))); // Shaddah
      expect(normalized, equals('كتاب الام للامام الشافعي'));
    });

    test('ArabicUtils unifies alif variants (أ, إ, آ, ٱ -> ا)', () {
      expect(ArabicUtils.normalize('أحمد'), equals('احمد'));
      expect(ArabicUtils.normalize('إبراهيم'), equals('ابراهيم'));
      expect(ArabicUtils.normalize('آدم'), equals('ادم'));
      expect(ArabicUtils.normalize('ٱبن'), equals('ابن'));
    });

    test('ArabicUtils unifies Ta Marbuthah and Ya Makhfufah', () {
      expect(ArabicUtils.normalize('رسالة'), equals('رساله'));
      expect(ArabicUtils.normalize('موسى'), equals('موسي'));
      expect(ArabicUtils.normalize('فتوى'), equals('فتوي'));
    });

    test('ArabicUtils.matches matches text with and without harakat', () {
      const source = 'الإِمَامُ أَبُو حَامِدٍ الغَزَالِيُّ';
      expect(ArabicUtils.matches(source, 'الغزالي'), isTrue);
      expect(ArabicUtils.matches(source, 'أبو حامد'), isTrue);
      expect(ArabicUtils.matches(source, 'ابو حامد'), isTrue); // Bare alif matches
      expect(ArabicUtils.matches(source, 'الامام'), isTrue); // Bare alif matches
    });

    test('CanonicalLibraryService.filterBooks finds books with diacritic variations', () {
      final books = [
        const CanonicalBookPresentation(
          editionId: 'umm',
          titleArabic: 'كِتَابُ الأُمِّ',
          authorArabic: 'الإِمَامُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ الشَّافِعِيُّ',
          titleLatin: 'Kitab Al-Umm',
          authorLatin: 'Imam Asy-Syafi\'i',
          reviewedEraLabel: 'Mutaqaddimin',
          reviewedTypeLabel: 'Asal Mazhab',
          publisher: 'Darul Kutub Al-Ilmiyyah',
          muhaqqiq: 'Dr. Rifa\'at',
        ),
        const CanonicalBookPresentation(
          editionId: 'tanbih',
          titleArabic: 'التَّنْبِيهُ فِي الفِقْهِ الشَّافِعِيِّ',
          authorArabic: 'أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الشِّيرَازِيُّ',
          titleLatin: 'At-Tanbih',
          reviewedEraLabel: 'Mutaqaddimin',
          reviewedTypeLabel: 'Matan',
        ),
      ];

      final service = CanonicalLibraryService.instance;

      // Search with bare alif 'الام'
      final res1 = service.filterBooks(books, 'الام');
      expect(res1.length, equals(1));
      expect(res1.first.editionId, equals('umm'));

      // Search with unvowelled 'الشافعي'
      final res2 = service.filterBooks(books, 'الشافعي');
      expect(res2.length, equals(2)); // Both mention Syafi'i (author / title)

      // Search with unvowelled 'الشيرازي'
      final res3 = service.filterBooks(books, 'الشيرازي');
      expect(res3.length, equals(1));
      expect(res3.first.editionId, equals('tanbih'));

      // Search by publisher
      final res4 = service.filterBooks(books, 'Ilmiyyah');
      expect(res4.length, equals(1));
      expect(res4.first.editionId, equals('umm'));

      // Search by muhaqqiq
      final res5 = service.filterBooks(books, 'Rifa\'at');
      expect(res5.length, equals(1));
      expect(res5.first.editionId, equals('umm'));
    });
  });
}
```

### TEST FILE: openturath_ai/test/audit_auth_stream_test.dart
```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/services/session_user_stream.dart';

Future<void> tick() => Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
void main() {
  test('A09 delayed old cache cannot emit or subscribe after logout', () async {
    final auth = StreamController<String?>.broadcast(sync: true);
    final oldCache = Completer<String?>();
    final watched = <String>[];
    final stream = sessionUserStream<String>(
      auth: auth.stream,
      cached: (uid) => oldCache.future,
      watch: (uid) { watched.add(uid); return const Stream<String?>.empty(); },
    );
    final values = <String?>[];
    final sub = stream.listen(values.add);
    auth.add('A');
    await tick();
    auth.add(null);
    await tick();
    oldCache.complete('A cached');
    await tick();
    expect(values.last, isNull);
    expect(values, isNot(contains('A cached')));
    expect(watched, isEmpty);
    await sub.cancel();
    await auth.close();
  });
  test('A09 final cancellation invalidates pending cache and later listeners restart', () async {
    final auth = StreamController<String?>.broadcast(sync: true);
    final cache = Completer<String?>();
    var watches = 0;
    final stream = sessionUserStream<String>(auth: auth.stream, cached: (_) => cache.future,
      watch: (_) { watches++; return const Stream<String?>.empty(); });
    final sub = stream.listen((_) {});
    auth.add('A');
    await tick();
    await sub.cancel();
    cache.complete('A');
    await tick();
    expect(watches, 0);
    final values = <String?>[];
    final next = stream.listen(values.add);
    auth.add(null);
    await tick();
    expect(values.last, isNull);
    await next.cancel();
    await auth.close();
  });
}
```

### TEST FILE: openturath_ai/test/audit_storage_test.dart
```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/services/scoped_json_store.dart';

class MemoryStrings implements StringStore {
  final values = <String, String>{};
  bool fail = false;
  Completer<void>? gate;
  int writes = 0;
  @override
  Future<String?> read(String key) async => values[key];
  @override
  Future<bool> write(String key, String value) async {
    writes++;
    await gate?.future;
    if (fail) return false;
    values[key] = value;
    return true;
  }
}

void main() {
  ScopedJsonListStore<String> store(MemoryStrings io) => ScopedJsonListStore(
    storage: io, decode: (map) => map['value'] as String,
    encode: (value) => {'value': value},
  );
  test('A07 values never cross account keys or caller mutation', () async {
    final io = MemoryStrings();
    final data = store(io);
    await data.replace('user-a', ['private']);
    expect(await data.read('user-b'), isEmpty);
    final a = await data.read('user-a');
    a.clear();
    expect(await data.read('user-a'), ['private']);
  });
  test('A08 parallel updates through separate instances preserve both records', () async {
    final io = MemoryStrings();
    final a = store(io);
    final b = store(io);
    await Future.wait([
      a.update('notes', (rows) => rows..add('A')),
      b.update('notes', (rows) => rows..add('B')),
    ]);
    expect(await a.read('notes'), ['A', 'B']);
  });
  testWidgets('A08 slow write does not release exclusion after five seconds', (tester) async {
    final io = MemoryStrings()..gate = Completer<void>();
    final data = store(io);
    final first = data.replace('slow', ['A']);
    final next = data.update('slow', (rows) => rows..add('B'));
    await tester.pump();
    await tester.pump(const Duration(seconds: 6));
    expect(io.writes, 1);
    io.gate!.complete();
    await tester.pump();
    await Future.wait([first, next]);
    expect(await data.read('slow'), ['A', 'B']);
  });
  test('A08 failed write surfaces error and releases queue', () async {
    final io = MemoryStrings()..fail = true;
    final data = store(io);
    await expectLater(data.replace('k', ['lost']), throwsStateError);
    io.fail = false;
    await data.replace('k', ['saved']);
    expect(await data.read('k'), ['saved']);
  });
  test('A07 corrupted payload is preserved before any replacement', () async {
    final io = MemoryStrings()..values['a'] = '[broken';
    final data = store(io);
    await data.update('a', (rows) => rows..add('new'));
    expect(io.values.entries.where((e) => e.key.startsWith('a_corrupt_')).single.value, '[broken');
    expect(await data.read('b'), isEmpty);
  });
  test('A07 failed quarantine prevents overwriting corrupt original', () async {
    final io = MemoryStrings()..values['a'] = '[broken'..fail = true;
    await expectLater(store(io).replace('a', ['new']), throwsStateError);
    expect(io.values['a'], '[broken');
  });
}
```

```dart
void main() {
  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  setUp(() {
    SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({});
  });

  BookmarkModel createSampleBookmark({
    required String id,
    required String title,
    String fieldName = 'Fiqih',
    String arabicExcerpt = '',
    String fullAnswer = 'Isi catatan',
  }) {
    return BookmarkModel(
      id: id,
      title: title,
      agentId: 'fiqh',
      agentTitle: 'Fikih & Ushul',
      fieldName: fieldName,
      fieldId: 'fiqh',
      arabicExcerpt: arabicExcerpt,
      fullAnswer: fullAnswer,
      bookReference: 'Fath al-Qarib',
      pageNumber: '12',
      createdAt: DateTime.now(),
    );
  }

  group('BookmarkService Offline-First & Cloud Sync Tests', () {
    test('addBookmark stores item locally and notifies listeners', () async {
      final service = BookmarkService();
      var notificationCount = 0;
      service.addListener(() => notificationCount++);

      final bookmark = createSampleBookmark(
        id: 'note_1',
        title: 'Catatan Fiqh',
        arabicExcerpt: 'كتاب الصلاة',
        fullAnswer: 'Penjelasan rukun shalat.',
      );

      await service.addBookmark(bookmark, userId: 'user_a');
      final list = await service.getBookmarks(userId: 'user_a');

      expect(list.length, 1);
      expect(list.first.title, 'Catatan Fiqh');
      expect(list.first.arabicExcerpt, 'كتاب الصلاة');
      expect(notificationCount, greaterThan(0));
    });

    test('deleteBookmark removes item locally and notifies listeners', () async {
      final service = BookmarkService();
      var notificationCount = 0;
      service.addListener(() => notificationCount++);

      final bookmark = createSampleBookmark(
        id: 'note_to_delete',
        title: 'Catatan Hapus',
        fieldName: 'Tafsir',
        fullAnswer: 'Uraian ayat.',
      );

      await service.addBookmark(bookmark, userId: 'user_a');
      expect((await service.getBookmarks(userId: 'user_a')).length, 1);

      await service.deleteBookmark('note_to_delete', userId: 'user_a');
      expect((await service.getBookmarks(userId: 'user_a')).length, 0);
      expect(notificationCount, greaterThanOrEqualTo(2));
    });

    test('deleted note remains as a hidden sync tombstone', () async {
      final service = BookmarkService();
      final bookmark = createSampleBookmark(id: 'tombstone', title: 'Hapus aman');
      await service.addBookmark(bookmark, userId: 'user_tombstone');
      await service.deleteBookmark(bookmark.id, userId: 'user_tombstone');

      expect(await service.getBookmarks(userId: 'user_tombstone'), isEmpty);
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final raw = prefs.getString('openturath_user_tombstone_saved_bookmarks')!;
      final stored = BookmarkModel.fromJson(
        Map<String, dynamic>.from((jsonDecode(raw) as List).single as Map),
      );
      expect(stored.isDeleted, isTrue);
      expect(stored.deletedAt, isNotNull);
    });

    test('syncWithCloud seamlessly migrates legacy anonymous bookmarks to logged-in user', () async {
      final legacyBookmark = createSampleBookmark(
        id: 'legacy_1',
        title: 'Catatan Warisan Versi Lama',
        fieldName: 'Hadis',
        arabicExcerpt: 'إنما الأعمال بالنيات',
        fullAnswer: 'Hadis pertama Bukhari tentang niat.',
      );

      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setStringList(
        'openturath_saved_bookmarks',
        [jsonEncode(legacyBookmark.toJson())],
      );

      final service = BookmarkService();
      // Initially, user_logged_in has no bookmarks
      final initialUserList = await service.getBookmarks(userId: 'user_logged_in');
      expect(initialUserList, isEmpty);

      // Trigger cloud sync for user_logged_in
      await service.syncWithCloud(userId: 'user_logged_in');

      // Now user_logged_in should have the migrated bookmark
      final updatedUserList = await service.getBookmarks(userId: 'user_logged_in');
      expect(updatedUserList.length, 1);
      expect(updatedUserList.first.id, 'legacy_1');
      expect(updatedUserList.first.title, 'Catatan Warisan Versi Lama');
      expect(updatedUserList.first.arabicExcerpt, 'إنما الأعمال بالنيات');
    });

    test('isBookmarked accurately checks existence per user', () async {
      final service = BookmarkService();
      final bookmark = createSampleBookmark(
        id: 'item_check',
        title: 'Cek Ada',
      );

      expect(await service.isBookmarked('item_check', userId: 'user_x'), isFalse);
      await service.addBookmark(bookmark, userId: 'user_x');
      expect(await service.isBookmarked('item_check', userId: 'user_x'), isTrue);
      expect(await service.isBookmarked('item_check', userId: 'user_y'), isFalse);
    });

    test('BookmarkModel serialization supports updatedAt and effectiveTime correctly', () {
      final t1 = DateTime(2026, 9, 10, 10, 0);
      final t2 = DateTime(2026, 9, 14, 12, 30);

      final modelWithoutUpdate = BookmarkModel(
        id: 'm1',
        title: 'Title 1',
        agentId: 'fiqh',
        agentTitle: 'Fikih',
        fieldName: 'Fiqih',
        fieldId: 'fiqh',
        arabicExcerpt: 'نص',
        fullAnswer: 'Isi',
        bookReference: 'Kitab',
        pageNumber: '1',
        createdAt: t1,
      );

      expect(modelWithoutUpdate.effectiveTime, t1);

      final modelWithUpdate = modelWithoutUpdate.copyWith(
        fullAnswer: 'Catatan tambahan yang diperbarui',
        updatedAt: t2,
      );

      expect(modelWithUpdate.effectiveTime, t2);
      expect(modelWithUpdate.fullAnswer, 'Catatan tambahan yang diperbarui');

      final json = modelWithUpdate.toJson();
      expect(json['updatedAt'], t2.toIso8601String());

      final restored = BookmarkModel.fromJson(json);
      expect(restored.updatedAt, t2);
      expect(restored.effectiveTime, t2);
      expect(restored.fullAnswer, 'Catatan tambahan yang diperbarui');
    });

    test('BookmarkService sorts items by effectiveTime descending', () async {
      final service = BookmarkService();
      final tOld = DateTime(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0);
      final tMid = DateTime(2026, 9, 5, 10, 0);
      final tNew = DateTime(2026, 9, 14, 10, 0);

      final oldNote = BookmarkModel(
        id: 'note_old',
        title: 'Catatan Lama',
        agentId: 'fiqh',
        agentTitle: 'Fikih',
        fieldName: 'Fiqih',
        fieldId: 'fiqh',
        arabicExcerpt: '',
        fullAnswer: 'Lama',
        bookReference: 'Kitab',
        pageNumber: '1',
        createdAt: tOld,
      );

      final newNote = BookmarkModel(
        id: 'note_new',
        title: 'Catatan Baru',
        agentId: 'fiqh',
        agentTitle: 'Fikih',
        fieldName: 'Fiqih',
        fieldId: 'fiqh',
        arabicExcerpt: '',
        fullAnswer: 'Baru',
        bookReference: 'Kitab',
        pageNumber: '2',
        createdAt: tMid,
        updatedAt: tNew, // effectiveTime paling baru
      );

      await service.addBookmark(oldNote, userId: 'user_sort');
      await service.addBookmark(newNote, userId: 'user_sort');

      final results = await service.getBookmarks(userId: 'user_sort');
      expect(results.length, 2);
      expect(results[0].id, 'note_new'); // Paling baru harus di atas
      expect(results[1].id, 'note_old');
    });
  });
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:io';

void main() {
  group('Canonical Syafi\'i Catalog Parser Tests', () {
    test('parses canonical_syafii.json correctly with 87 entries', () {
      final file = File('assets/data/canonical_syafii.json');
      expect(file.existsSync(), isTrue, reason: 'assets/data/canonical_syafii.json must exist');

      final content = file.readAsStringSync();
      final result = parseCanonicalCatalog(content);

      expect(result.entries.isNotEmpty, isTrue);
      expect(result.entries.length, equals(87), reason: 'Expected 87 canonical books');
      expect(result.issues.isEmpty, isTrue, reason: 'Expected 0 format issues in catalog: ${result.issues}');

      // Verify sample entry: Al-Umm
      final alUmm = result.entries.firstWhere((e) => e.shortTitleArabic == 'الأم');
      expect(alUmm.titleArabic, equals('الأم'));
      expect(alUmm.authorArabic, equals('الإمام الشافعي'));
      expect(alUmm.recordedDeathYearHijri, equals(204));
      expect(alUmm.recordedVolumes, equals(8));
      expect(alUmm.publisher, isNotNull);

      // Verify Presentation conversion does not leak raw authority badges prematurely
      final presentation = CanonicalBookPresentation.fromEntry(alUmm);
      expect(presentation.reviewedAuthorityLabel, isNull);
      expect(presentation.canShowAuthority, isFalse);
      expect(presentation.reviewedTypeLabel, equals('Asal Mazhab'));
      expect(presentation.reviewedEraLabel, equals('Mutaqaddimin'));
      expect(presentation.compactLabels, contains('Asal Mazhab'));
      expect(presentation.compactLabels, contains('8 Jilid'));
    });
  });
}
```

```dart
          "الاسم_المختصر": "صحيح البخاري",
          "الكتاب": "الجامع المسند الصحيح المختصر من أمور رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وسننه وأيامه",

          "عدد_الصفحات": "3882",
          "id": 101
        }
      ]
      ''';

      final books = parseSyamilahCatalog(sampleHadithJson);
      expect(books.length, equals(1));
      final b = books.first;
      expect(b.editionId, equals('101'));
      expect(b.verifiedDeathYearHijri, equals(256));
      expect(b.sectionArabic, equals('كتب السنة'));
      expect(b.shortTitleArabic, equals('صحيح البخاري'));
      expect(b.pagesDescription, equals('3882'));
      expect(b.compactLabels, contains('3882 Hlm'));
      expect(b.titleArabic, contains('الجامع المسند'));
      expect(b.authorArabic, contains('البخاري'));
      expect(b.muhaqqiq, contains('محمد زهير'));
      expect(b.publisher, equals('دار طوق النجاة'));
      expect(b.printYear, equals('1422هـ'));
      expect(b.volumesDescription, equals('9'));
      expect(b.volumesCount, equals(9));

    test('CanonicalLibraryService filterBooks filters by century, section, and query with harakat', () {
      final books = [
        const CanonicalBookPresentation(
          editionId: '1',
          titleArabic: 'صَحِيحُ البُخَارِيِّ',
          shortTitleArabic: 'صحيح البخاري',
          authorArabic: 'الإمام البخاري',
          verifiedDeathYearHijri: 256,
          sectionArabic: 'كتب السنة',
          muhaqqiq: 'زهير الناصر',
        ),
        const CanonicalBookPresentation(
          editionId: '2',
          titleArabic: 'فَتْحُ البَارِي شَرْحُ صَحِيحِ البُخَارِي',
          shortTitleArabic: 'فتح الباري',
          authorArabic: 'ابن حجر العسقلاني',
          verifiedDeathYearHijri: 852,
          sectionArabic: 'كتب السنة',
          muhaqqiq: 'محب الدين الخطيب',
        ),
        const CanonicalBookPresentation(
          editionId: '3',
          titleArabic: 'الكشاف عن حقائق غوامض التنزيل',
          shortTitleArabic: 'تفسير الزمخشري',
          authorArabic: 'الزمخشري',
          verifiedDeathYearHijri: 538,
          sectionArabic: 'التفسير وعلوم القرآن (Balaghah)',
        ),
      ];

      final service = CanonicalLibraryService.instance;

      // 1. Search without diacritics finding diacritic title
      final r1 = service.filterBooks(books, 'صحيح البخاري');
      expect(r1.length, equals(2));

      // 2. Search by author with diacritic variation
      final r2 = service.filterBooks(books, 'البخاري');
      expect(r2.length, equals(2));

      // 3. Century Filter: Salaf (<= 300 H)
      final r3 = service.filterBooks(books, '', centuryFilter: 'Salaf (≤ 300 H)');
      expect(r3.length, equals(1));
      expect(r3.first.editionId, equals('1'));

      // 4. Century Filter: Muta'akhkhirin (601-1100 H)
      final r4 = service.filterBooks(books, '', centuryFilter: 'Muta\'akhkhirin (601-1100 H)');
      expect(r4.length, equals(1));
      expect(r4.first.editionId, equals('2'));

      // 5. Section filter
      final r5 = service.filterBooks(books, '', sectionFilter: 'التفسير وعلوم القرآن (Balaghah)');
      expect(r5.length, equals(1));
      expect(r5.first.editionId, equals('3'));
    });
  });
}
```

### TEST FILE: openturath_ai/test/copied_answer_test.dart
```dart
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/core/copied_answer.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/models/agent_model.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/services/bookmark_service.dart';

void main() {
  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  setUp(() => SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({}));
  test('Copied answer persists in Saved, keeps full text, and never crosses accounts', () async {
    final service = BookmarkService();
    final agent = AgentModel.defaultAgents.first;
    final answer = copiedAnswerBookmark('Jawaban pertama\nالنص العربي', agent);
    await service.addBookmark(answer, userId: 'alice');
    final saved = await service.getBookmarks(userId: 'alice');
    expect(saved.single.fullAnswer, 'Jawaban pertama\nالنص العربي');
    expect(saved.single.agentId, agent.id);
    expect(await service.getBookmarks(userId: 'bob'), isEmpty);
  });
  test('Repeated copy deduplicates but different answers and assistants stay separate', () async {
    final service = BookmarkService();
    final agents = AgentModel.defaultAgents;
    for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      await service.addBookmark(copiedAnswerBookmark('Jawaban satu', agents.first), userId: 'alice');
    }
    expect((await service.getBookmarks(userId: 'alice')).length, 1);
    await service.addBookmark(copiedAnswerBookmark('Jawaban dua', agents.first), userId: 'alice');
    await service.addBookmark(copiedAnswerBookmark('Jawaban satu', agents[1]), userId: 'alice');
    expect((await service.getBookmarks(userId: 'alice')).length, 3);
  });
  test('Empty copies cannot create a saved item', () {
    expect(() => copiedAnswerBookmark('  ', AgentModel.defaultAgents.first), throwsArgumentError);
  });
}
```

### TEST FILE: openturath_ai/test/copywriting_test.dart
```dart
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/core/app_copy.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/models/agent_model.dart';

void main() {
  group('OpenTurath Copywriting Overhaul — Quiet Scholar Principles v2', () {
    test('Canonical navigation labels use concise, quiet terms', () {
      expect(AppCopy.navHome, equals('Beranda'));
      expect(AppCopy.navStudies, equals('Asisten'));
      expect(AppCopy.navSaved, equals('Catatan'));
      expect(AppCopy.navSettings, equals('Pengaturan'));
    });

    test('Canonical app name and tagline are concise and avoid superlatives', () {
      expect(AppCopy.appName, equals('OpenTurath'));
      expect(AppCopy.appTagline, equals('Membaca kitab, menelusuri ibarah.'));
    });

    test('Success toasts never use exclamation marks (!)', () {
      expect(AppCopy.savedSuccess.contains('!'), isFalse,
          reason: 'Success messages should be calm and not use exclamation marks');
      expect(AppCopy.answerCopied.contains('!'), isFalse,
          reason: 'Copy action should be quiet and not use exclamation marks');
      expect(AppCopy.deleteAccountSuccess.contains('!'), isFalse);
    });

    test('Public strings do not contain prohibited marketing or academic jargon', () {
      final prohibitedWords = [
        'korpus',
        'ruang riset',
        'ai spesialis',
        'naskah primer',
        'kurasi kebahasaan',
        'penelaahan',
        'fasilitas',
        'komprehensif',
        'secara menyeluruh',
        'berbasis',
        'terintegrasi',
        'optimal',
        'presisi',
        'solusi',
      ];

      final samplePublicStrings = [
        AppCopy.aboutDescription,
        AppCopy.aboutScholarlyPrinciple,
        AppCopy.adabHeading1,
        AppCopy.adabBody1,
        AppCopy.adabHeading2,
        AppCopy.adabBody2,
        AppCopy.deviceNotSupportedTitle,
        AppCopy.deviceNotSupportedMessage,
        AppCopy.cannotConnectTitle,
        AppCopy.cannotConnectMessage,
        AppCopy.noSavedTitle,
        AppCopy.noSavedDescription,
        AppCopy.catalogLoadFailed,
        AppCopy.activeSubscription,
        AppCopy.inactiveSubscription,
        AppCopy.googleSessionConnectTitle,
        AppCopy.googleSessionConnectSubtitle,
        AppCopy.googleSessionConnectDesc,
        AppCopy.googleSessionSignInHint,
        AppCopy.packagePerField,
        AppCopy.packageAllFields,
        AppCopy.packageAllFieldsPreparing,
        AppCopy.sessionExpiredOrNoAccess,
        AppCopy.agentLoadFailed,
      ];

      for (final text in samplePublicStrings) {
        final lower = text.toLowerCase();
        for (final word in prohibitedWords) {
          expect(lower.contains(word), isFalse,
              reason: 'String "$text" should not contain prohibited word "$word"');
        }
      }
    });

    test('AgentModel defaultAgents descriptions and titles avoid banned jargon', () {
      final prohibitedInAgents = [
        'korpus',
        'fasilitas',
        'komprehensif',
        'secara menyeluruh',
        'solusi',
        'optimal',
        'ai spesialis',
      ];

      for (final agent in AgentModel.defaultAgents) {
        final refTitles = (agent.referenceBooks ?? []).map((b) => '${b.title} ${b.description}').join(' ');
        final combined = '${agent.title} ${agent.description} $refTitles'.toLowerCase();
        for (final word in prohibitedInAgents) {
          expect(combined.contains(word), isFalse,
              reason: 'Agent ${agent.id} contains prohibited word "$word": $combined');
        }
      }
    });

    test('Dynamic interpolation helpers produce serene, well-formed phrases', () {
      expect(AppCopy.preparingModule('Fikih Syafi\'i'),
          equals('Fikih Syafi\'i sedang disiapkan.'));
      expect(AppCopy.subscriptionRequiredFor('Fikih Syafi\'i'),
          equals('Berlangganan untuk membuka Fikih Syafi\'i.'));
      expect(AppCopy.accessUnavailableFor('Fikih Syafi\'i'),
          equals('Akses ke Fikih Syafi\'i belum aktif. Pilih paket atau gunakan voucher untuk melanjutkan.'));
      expect(AppCopy.planWithAgent('Fikih Syafi\'i', '1 Bulan'),
          equals('Fikih Syafi\'i — 1 Bulan'));
    });

    test('UI screens and widgets do not leak prohibited terms into user-facing code', () {
      // Subscription screen uses commercial SaaS conversion copy as requested by product owner
      final filesToScan = [
        'lib/screens/google_session_auth_screen.dart',
        'lib/screens/profile_screen.dart',
        'lib/screens/dashboard_screen.dart',
        'lib/screens/library_screen.dart',
        'lib/screens/book_catalog_screen.dart',
        'lib/screens/bookmark_screen.dart',
        'lib/widgets/app_error_state.dart',
        'lib/widgets/evidence_bottom_sheet.dart',
        'lib/widgets/openturath_brand.dart',
      ];

      final bannedPatterns = [
        RegExp(r"['\x22][^'\x22]*ruang\s+riset[^'\x22]*['\x22]", caseSensitive: false),
        RegExp(r"['\x22][^'\x22]*ai\s+spesialis[^'\x22]*['\x22]", caseSensitive: false),
        RegExp(r"['\x22][^'\x22]*naskah\s+primer[^'\x22]*['\x22]", caseSensitive: false),
        RegExp(r"['\x22][^'\x22]*kurasi\s+kebahasaan[^'\x22]*['\x22]", caseSensitive: false),
        RegExp(r"['\x22][^'\x22]*autentikasi\s+sesi[^'\x22]*['\x22]", caseSensitive: false),
        RegExp(r"['\x22][^'\x22]*modul\s+telaah[^'\x22]*['\x22]", caseSensitive: false),
        RegExp(r"['\x22][^'\x22]*memproses\s+telaah[^'\x22]*['\x22]", caseSensitive: false),
      ];

      for (final path in filesToScan) {
        final file = File(path);
        if (!file.existsSync()) continue;
        final lines = file.readAsLinesSync();
        for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
          final line = lines[i];
          final trimmed = line.trim();
          if (trimmed.startsWith('//') && !trimmed.contains("Text(")) continue;
          for (final pattern in bannedPatterns) {
            expect(
              pattern.hasMatch(line),
              isFalse,
              reason: 'Banned user-facing term matched ${pattern.pattern} in $path at line ${i + 1}:\n$line',
            );
          }
        }
      }
    });
  });
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/services/device_service.dart';

void main() {
  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  group('DeviceService & Fingerprint Hashing', () {
    test('computeHash produces valid 64-char lowercase hex string', () {
      final hash = DeviceService.computeHash(
        rawId: '4a6b8c0d1e2f3a4b',
        brand: 'Samsung',
        model: 'SM-S918B',
      );

      expect(hash.length, equals(64));
      expect(RegExp(r'^[a-f0-9]{64}$').hasMatch(hash), isTrue);
    });

    test('computeHash is case-insensitive for brand and model normalization', () {
      final hash1 = DeviceService.computeHash(
        rawId: 'android_id_123',
        brand: 'SAMSUNG',
        model: 'Galaxy-A54',
      );
      final hash2 = DeviceService.computeHash(
        rawId: 'android_id_123',
        brand: 'samsung',
        model: 'galaxy-a54',
      );

      expect(hash1, equals(hash2));
    });

    test('Different rawId produces distinct hashes (avalanche effect)', () {
      final hashA = DeviceService.computeHash(
        rawId: 'device_alpha',
        brand: 'xiaomi',
        model: 'redmi_12',
      );
      final hashB = DeviceService.computeHash(
        rawId: 'device_beta',
        brand: 'xiaomi',
        model: 'redmi_12',
      );

      expect(hashA, isNot(equals(hashB)));
    });

    test('getDeviceFingerprint returns a non-empty fingerprint safely in test environment', () async {
      final service = DeviceService();
      final fp = await service.getDeviceFingerprint();

      expect(fp.deviceId.length, equals(64));
      expect(fp.model.isNotEmpty, isTrue);
      expect(fp.brand.isNotEmpty, isTrue);
    });
  });
}
```

### TEST FILE: openturath_ai/test/doku_direct_test.dart
```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

void main() {
  test('DOKU Signature generation satisfies DOKU HMACSHA256 protocol specification', () {
    const clientId = 'TEST-CLIENT-ID-123';
    const secretKey = 'TEST-SECRET-KEY-456';
    const requestId = 'REQ-12345';
    const timestamp = '2026-09-07T12:00:00Z';
    const targetPath = '/checkout/v1/payment';
    const rawBody = '{"order":{"amount":50000}}';

    final digest = base64Encode(sha256.convert(utf8.encode(rawBody)).bytes);
    final signatureComponent =
        'Client-Id:$clientId\nRequest-Id:$requestId\nRequest-Timestamp:$timestamp\nRequest-Target:$targetPath\nDigest:$digest';
    final hmac = base64Encode(Hmac(sha256, utf8.encode(secretKey)).convert(utf8.encode(signatureComponent)).bytes);
    final signature = 'HMACSHA256=$hmac';

    expect(signature.startsWith('HMACSHA256='), isTrue);
    expect(signature.length, greaterThan(20));
  });

  test('Direct DOKU Checkout API returns HTTP 200 with checkout URL when env configured', () async {
    final clientId = Platform.environment['DOKU_CLIENT_ID'];
    final secretKey = Platform.environment['DOKU_SECRET_KEY'];
    if (clientId == null || secretKey == null) {
      // Lewati live API call jika kredensial privat tidak di-inject via CI/CD environment
      return;
    }
    const baseUrl = 'https://api-sandbox.doku.com';
    const targetPath = '/checkout/v1/payment';

    final invoiceNumber = 'DART-TEST-${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}';
    final requestBody = {
      'order': {
        'amount': 49000,
        'invoice_number': invoiceNumber,
        'callback_url': 'https://openturath-ai.web.app',
        'line_items': [
          {
            'name': 'Test Paket Tholib (1 Bulan)',
            'price': 49000,
            'quantity': 1,
          }
        ],
      },
      'payment': {
        'payment_due_date': 120,
      },
      'customer': {
        'name': 'Peneliti Test',
        'email': 'test.peneliti@openturath.ai',
        'phone': '081234567890',
      },
    };

    final rawBody = jsonEncode(requestBody);
    final requestId = 'REQ-${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}-${Random().nextInt(9000) + 1000}';
    final timestamp = '${DateTime.now().toUtc().toIso8601String().substring(0, 19)}Z';

    final digest = base64Encode(sha256.convert(utf8.encode(rawBody)).bytes);
    final signatureComponent = 'Client-Id:$clientId\nRequest-Id:$requestId\nRequest-Timestamp:$timestamp\nRequest-Target:$targetPath\nDigest:$digest';
    final hmac = base64Encode(Hmac(sha256, utf8.encode(secretKey)).convert(utf8.encode(signatureComponent)).bytes);
    final signature = 'HMACSHA256=$hmac';

    final client = HttpClient();
    try {
      final request = await client.postUrl(Uri.parse('$baseUrl$targetPath'));
      request.headers.set('Client-Id', clientId);
      request.headers.set('Request-Id', requestId);
      request.headers.set('Request-Timestamp', timestamp);
      request.headers.set('Signature', signature);
      request.headers.set(HttpHeaders.contentTypeHeader, 'application/json');
      request.add(utf8.encode(rawBody));

      final response = await request.close();
      final responseBody = await response.transform(utf8.decoder).join();
      expect(response.statusCode, 200);
      final json = jsonDecode(responseBody) as Map<String, dynamic>;
      final url = json['response']?['payment']?['url'] as String?;
      expect(url, isNotNull);
      expect(url!.startsWith('https://staging.doku.com/checkout-link-v2/'), isTrue);
    } on SocketException catch (_) {
      // Offline / Sandbox test environment
    } finally {
      client.close();
    }
  });
}
```

```dart
    test('AgentModel defaultAgents contains 5 standard fiqh specialists and 1 independent tahawwulat', () {

        'fiqh_maliki',
        'fiqh_hanbali',
        'fiqh_muqaran',
```

### TEST FILE: openturath_ai/test/hardening_and_redeem_test.dart
```dart
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/core/hijri_date_utils.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/models/agent_model.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/models/user_model.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/screens/agent_webview_screen.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/services/subscription_service.dart';

void main() {
  group('System Hardening & Entitlement Suite', () {
    test('All active agents have consistent pricing catalog', () {
      final activeAgents = AgentModel.defaultAgents.where((a) => a.isActive).toList();
      expect(activeAgents.isNotEmpty, isTrue);

      for (final agent in activeAgents) {
        expect(agent.price1m, isNotNull);
        expect(agent.price1m!, greaterThan(0));
        // Fikih Tahawwulat adalah korpus berdaulat independen (300.000 IDR), modul lain standar (49.000 IDR)
        if (agent.id == 'fiqh_tahawwulat') {
          expect(agent.price1m, equals(300000));
        } else {
          expect(agent.price1m, equals(49000));
        }
      }
    });

    test('UserModel modular entitlement grants access when active and not expired', () {
      final futureExpiry = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 7));
      final user = UserModel(
        uid: 'user_active_7d',
        name: 'Santri Riset',
        email: 'santri@example.com',
        photoUrl: '',
        plan: 'custom',
        questionsUsed: 0,
        entitlements: {
          'fiqh_syafii': ModuleEntitlement(
            plan: 'redeem_7d',
            expiry: futureExpiry,
            status: 'active',
          ),
        },
      );

      expect(user.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_syafii'), isTrue);
      // Does not grant access to unowned agents
      expect(user.hasAccessToAgent('hadits'), isFalse);
    });

    test('UserModel modular entitlement denies access when expired', () {
      final pastExpiry = DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(days: 1));
      final user = UserModel(
        uid: 'user_expired',
        name: 'Santri Expired',
        email: 'santri_exp@example.com',
        photoUrl: '',
        plan: 'custom',
        questionsUsed: 0,
        entitlements: {
          'fiqh_syafii': ModuleEntitlement(
            plan: 'redeem_7d',
            expiry: pastExpiry,
            status: 'expired',
          ),
        },
      );

      expect(user.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_syafii'), isFalse);
    });

    test('Full bundle plan grants access to all active agents regardless of individual entitlements', () {
      final futureExpiry = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 30));
      final user = UserModel(
        uid: 'user_full_bundle',
        name: 'Santri Riset Lengkap',
        email: 'santri_full@example.com',
        photoUrl: '',
        plan: 'full',
        questionsUsed: 0,
        subscriptionExpiry: futureExpiry,
      );

      expect(user.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_syafii'), isTrue);
      expect(user.hasAccessToAgent('hadits'), isTrue);
      expect(user.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_tahawwulat'), isTrue);
    });

    test('URL security policy allows Google NotebookLM ecosystem and blocks external redirects (Production Code)', () {
      bool check(String urlStr) {
        final uri = Uri.tryParse(urlStr);
        if (uri == null) return false;
        return AgentWebviewScreen.isAllowedNotebookUrl(uri);
      }

      expect(check('https://notebooklm.google.com/notebook/abc-123'), isTrue);
      expect(check('https://accounts.google.com/ServiceLogin'), isTrue);
      expect(check('https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/roboto/v20/xyz.woff2'), isFalse); // Resource URL is not a top-level destination.
      expect(check('https://apis.google.com/js/api.js'), isFalse);
      expect(check('http://notebooklm.google.com'), isFalse); // HTTP insecure rejected
      expect(check('https://evil-phishing.com/notebooklm.google.com'), isFalse);
      expect(check('javascript:alert(1)'), isFalse);
      expect(check('file:///android_asset/something.html'), isFalse);
    });

    test('Redeem code normalization handles whitespace, casing, and dashes (Production Code)', () {
      expect(SubscriptionService.normalizeCode('  santri-7hari  '), equals('SANTRI7HARI'));
      expect(SubscriptionService.normalizeCode('FIKIH-SYAFII-2026'), equals('FIKIHSYAFII2026'));
      expect(SubscriptionService.normalizeCode('  voucher 123  '), equals('VOUCHER123'));
      expect(SubscriptionService.normalizeCode(' santri_123 '), equals('SANTRI_123'));
    });

    test('redeemErrorMessage formats neutral copy and preserves device protection messages', () {
      // 1. Standar kode sudah pernah dipakai (netral 'Kode ini')
      expect(
        SubscriptionService.redeemErrorMessage('already-exists'),
        equals('Kode ini sudah pernah ditukarkan sebelumnya.'),
      );

      // 2. Pesan proteksi perangkat dari server diteruskan utuh
      const deviceMsg = 'Kode ini hanya dapat diklaim 1 kali per perangkat. Perangkat ini sudah pernah mengaktifkannya sebelumnya.';
      expect(
        SubscriptionService.redeemErrorMessage('already-exists', deviceMsg),
        equals(deviceMsg),
      );

      // 3. Pesan proteksi ponsel fisik / anti emulator diteruskan utuh
      const emulatorMsg = 'Kode ini hanya dapat diaktifkan melalui ponsel fisik asli.';
      expect(
        SubscriptionService.redeemErrorMessage('failed-precondition', emulatorMsg),
        equals(emulatorMsg),
      );
    });

    test('addCalendarMonthsClamped correctly handles leap year 29 Feb and non-leap 28 Feb boundary conditions (F-11)', () {
      // 1. Tahun kabisat (2024): 31 Januari + 1 bulan = 29 Februari 2024
      final jan31Leap = DateTime(2024, 1, 31);
      final febLeap = HijriDateUtils.addCalendarMonthsClamped(jan31Leap, 1);
      expect(febLeap.year, equals(2024));
      expect(febLeap.month, equals(2));
      expect(febLeap.day, equals(29));

      // 2. Tahun non-kabisat (2025): 31 Januari + 1 bulan = 28 Februari 2025
      final jan31NonLeap = DateTime(2025, 1, 31);
      final febNonLeap = HijriDateUtils.addCalendarMonthsClamped(jan31NonLeap, 1);
      expect(febNonLeap.year, equals(2025));
      expect(febNonLeap.month, equals(2));
      expect(febNonLeap.day, equals(28));

      // 3. Dari 29 Februari kabisat (2024) + 12 bulan (1 tahun) = 28 Februari 2025 (non-kabisat)
      final leapFeb29 = DateTime(2024, 2, 29);
      final nextYearFeb = HijriDateUtils.addCalendarMonthsClamped(leapFeb29, 12);
      expect(nextYearFeb.year, equals(2025));
      expect(nextYearFeb.month, equals(2));
      expect(nextYearFeb.day, equals(28));

      // 4. 31 Maret + 1 bulan = 30 April
      final mar31 = DateTime(2024, 3, 31);
      final apr30 = HijriDateUtils.addCalendarMonthsClamped(mar31, 1);
      expect(apr30.month, equals(4));
      expect(apr30.day, equals(30));

      // 5. 31 Mei + 1 bulan = 30 Juni
      final may31 = DateTime(2024, 5, 31);
      final jun30 = HijriDateUtils.addCalendarMonthsClamped(may31, 1);
      expect(jun30.month, equals(6));
      expect(jun30.day, equals(30));
    });
  });
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/core/membership_pass_state.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/models/user_model.dart';

void main() {
  UserModel user(Map<String, ModuleEntitlement> entitlements) => UserModel(
        uid: 'u1', name: 'Udin', email: 'udin@example.com', photoUrl: '',
        plan: 'free', questionsUsed: 0, entitlements: entitlements,
      );

  test('presents a time-bound trial as Pro with remaining days', () {
    final summary = resolveMembershipPass(user({
      'fiqh': ModuleEntitlement(plan: 'trial', status: 'active', trialDurationDays: 3,
        expiry: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 2, hours: 2))),
    }));
    expect(summary.state, MembershipPassState.trialPro);
    expect(summary.badge, 'PRO');
    expect(summary.supportingLabel.toLowerCase(), contains('masa coba'));
  });

  test('uses nearest expiry and count for several individual AI accesses', () {
    final summary = resolveMembershipPass(user({
      'fiqh': ModuleEntitlement(plan: 'pro', expiry: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 8))),
      'hadis': ModuleEntitlement(plan: 'pro', expiry: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 2))),
      'tafsir': ModuleEntitlement(plan: 'pro', expiry: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 5))),
    }));
    expect(summary.state, MembershipPassState.expiringSoon);
    expect(summary.accessLabel, '3 asisten tersedia');
    expect(summary.expiryLabel, 'Berlaku hingga');
  });

  test('does not claim access while a payment is pending', () {
    final summary = resolveMembershipPass(user({
      'fiqh': const ModuleEntitlement(plan: 'pro', status: 'pending', paymentStatus: 'pending'),
    }));
    expect(summary.state, MembershipPassState.paymentPending);
    expect(summary.ctaLabel, 'Lihat status pembayaran');
  });

  test('keeps an active Pro pass open when another payment is pending', () {
    final user = UserModel(
      uid: 'u1', name: 'Udin', email: '', photoUrl: '', plan: 'free', questionsUsed: 0,
      entitlements: {
        'fiqh_syafii': ModuleEntitlement(
          plan: 'premium', expiry: DateTime(2026, 10, 1),
        ),
        'hadits': const ModuleEntitlement(
          plan: 'premium', status: 'pending', paymentStatus: 'pending',
        ),
      },
    );

    final pass = resolveMembershipPass(user, now: DateTime(2026, 9, 14));
    expect(pass.isOpen, isTrue);
    expect(pass.state, MembershipPassState.activePro);
  });

  test('locks a user without a valid entitlement', () {
    final summary = resolveMembershipPass(user(const {}));
    expect(summary.state, MembershipPassState.locked);
    expect(summary.ctaLabel, 'Pilih paket Pro');
  });

  test('keeps a legacy account-level Pro subscription open during migration', () {
    final legacy = UserModel(
      uid: 'legacy', name: 'Udin', email: 'u@example.com', photoUrl: '',
      plan: 'tholib_1m', questionsUsed: 0,
      subscriptionExpiry: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 10)),
    );
    expect(resolveMembershipPass(legacy).state, MembershipPassState.activePro);
  });
}
```

### TEST FILE: openturath_ai/test/navigation_guard_test.dart
```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/core/navigation_guard.dart';

void main() {
  setUp(() {
    NavigationGuard.resetForTesting();
  });

  group('NavigationGuard Single-Flight Tests', () {
    testWidgets('safePushNamed ignores concurrent duplicate navigation calls', (tester) async {
      int pushCallCount = 0;

      final testApp = MaterialApp(
        onGenerateRoute: (settings) {
          if (settings.name == '/test_sub') {
            pushCallCount++;
            return MaterialPageRoute(
              builder: (context) => const Scaffold(body: Text('Subscription Page')),
              settings: settings,
            );
          }
          return MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (context) => Scaffold(
              body: Center(
                child: ElevatedButton(
                  onPressed: () {
                    // Simulasikan 3 kali tap bersamaan saat lag
                    NavigationGuard.safePushNamed(context, '/test_sub');
                    NavigationGuard.safePushNamed(context, '/test_sub');
                    NavigationGuard.safePushNamed(context, '/test_sub');
                  },
                  child: const Text('Upgrade'),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      );

      await tester.pumpWidget(testApp);
      await tester.tap(find.text('Upgrade'));
      await tester.pumpAndSettle();

      expect(find.text('Subscription Page'), findsOneWidget);
      // Tepat 1 kali navigasi diproses, 2 panggilan duplikat lainnya diabaikan!
      expect(pushCallCount, equals(1));
    });

    testWidgets('safeNavigate executes only one action during concurrent invocations', (tester) async {
      int actionCount = 0;

      final testApp = MaterialApp(
        home: Builder(
          builder: (context) {
            return ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () {
                for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                  NavigationGuard.safeNavigate(context, () async {
                    await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 50));
                    actionCount++;
                    return true;
                  });
                }
              },
              child: const Text('Concurrent Action'),
            );
          },
        ),
      );

      await tester.pumpWidget(testApp);
      await tester.tap(find.text('Concurrent Action'));
      await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));
      await tester.pumpAndSettle();

      expect(actionCount, equals(1));
    });

    testWidgets('safePushNamed allows opening a child route while parent route is active on stack', (tester) async {
      int subPageOpened = 0;
      int termsPageOpened = 0;

      final testApp = MaterialApp(
        onGenerateRoute: (settings) {
          if (settings.name == '/subscription') {
            subPageOpened++;
            return MaterialPageRoute(
              builder: (context) => Scaffold(
                body: ElevatedButton(
                  onPressed: () {
                    // Buka child route terms dari dalam subscription
                    NavigationGuard.safePushNamed(context, '/terms');
                  },
                  child: const Text('Open Terms'),
                ),
              ),
              settings: settings,
            );
          } else if (settings.name == '/terms') {
            termsPageOpened++;
            return MaterialPageRoute(
              builder: (context) => const Scaffold(body: Text('Terms Page')),
              settings: settings,
            );
          }
          return MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (context) => Scaffold(
              body: ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  NavigationGuard.safePushNamed(context, '/subscription');
                },
                child: const Text('Go To Subscription'),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      );

      await tester.pumpWidget(testApp);
      await tester.tap(find.text('Go To Subscription'));
      await tester.pumpAndSettle();

      expect(subPageOpened, equals(1));
      expect(find.text('Open Terms'), findsOneWidget);

      // Jeda transisi 450ms berlalu
      await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));

      // Pengguna menekan Open Terms dari dalam halaman subscription
      await tester.tap(find.text('Open Terms'));
      await tester.pumpAndSettle();

      expect(termsPageOpened, equals(1));
      expect(find.text('Terms Page'), findsOneWidget);
    });
  });
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/core/theme.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/core/app_config.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/models/agent_model.dart';

void main() {
  group('Resilience & Compliance Suite', () {
    testWidgets('AppErrorState renders properly with retry and back buttons', (tester) async {
      bool retried = false;
      bool backPressed = false;

      await tester.pumpWidget(
        MaterialApp(
          theme: ThemeData.dark(),
          home: Scaffold(
            body: AppErrorState(
              title: 'Gagal Memuat Korpus',

              onBack: () => backPressed = true,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );

      expect(find.text('Gagal Memuat Korpus'), findsOneWidget);
      expect(find.text('Terjadi kendala koneksi saat menghubungi server.'), findsOneWidget);
      expect(find.text('Coba lagi'), findsOneWidget);
      expect(find.text('Kembali'), findsOneWidget);

      await tester.tap(find.text('Coba lagi'));
      expect(retried, isTrue);

      await tester.tap(find.text('Kembali'));
      expect(backPressed, isTrue);
    });

    test('AgentModel defaultAgents have complete Arabic metadata and no null pointer risks', () {

    test('UserModel hasAccessToAgent respects modular entitlements and expiry', () {

      final future = now.add(const Duration(days: 30));
      final past = now.subtract(const Duration(days: 1));

      final activeUser = UserModel(

            expiry: future,
          ),

      expect(activeUser.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_tahawwulat'), isTrue);

      final expiredUser = UserModel(
        uid: 'user_expired_1',
        email: 'santri_exp@openturath.ai',
        name: 'Santri Expired',
        photoUrl: '',
        plan: 'trial',
        questionsUsed: 10,
        entitlements: {
          'fiqh_tahawwulat': ModuleEntitlement(

            status: 'expired',
            expiry: past,
          ),
        },
      );

      expect(expiredUser.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_tahawwulat'), isFalse);
      expect(expiredUser.isTrialExhausted, isFalse);
    });

    test('ThemeData dark and light include hardened component themes', () {

      expect(lightTheme.inputDecorationTheme.filled, isTrue);
      expect(lightTheme.dialogTheme.backgroundColor, equals(AppTheme.surfaceCardLight));
    });

    test('Localization contains valid cancel key in all three languages', () {
      AppConfig.localeNotifier.value = 'id';
      expect(Loc.tr('cancel'), equals('Batal'));

      AppConfig.localeNotifier.value = 'en';
      expect(Loc.tr('cancel'), equals('Cancel'));

      AppConfig.localeNotifier.value = 'ar';
      expect(Loc.tr('cancel'), equals('إلغاء'));

      // Restore default
      AppConfig.localeNotifier.value = 'id';
    });

    test('BookmarkModel serializes and deserializes correctly', () {
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final bm = BookmarkModel(
        id: 'bm_test_1',
        title: 'Kaidah Fiqh',
        agentId: 'fiqh_syafii',
        agentTitle: 'AI Fikih Syafi\'i',
        fieldName: 'Fikih',
        fieldId: 'fiqh',
        arabicExcerpt: 'الْأُمُورُ بِمَقَاصِدِهَا',
        fullAnswer: 'Segala perkara bergantung pada niatnya.',
        bookReference: 'Al-Asybah wan-Nazhair',
        pageNumber: 'Hal. 10',
        createdAt: now,
      );

      final json = bm.toJson();

      expect(restored.id, equals('bm_test_1'));
```

### TEST FILE: openturath_ai/test/telemetry_service_test.dart
```dart
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/services/telemetry_service.dart';

void main() {
  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  group('TelemetryService Tests', () {
    final telemetry = TelemetryService.instance;

    test('sanitizeData masks sensitive tokens, passwords, and cookies', () {
      // 1. Bearer Token
      const withToken = 'Request header: Bearer ya29.a0AfH6SMD123456';
      expect(
        telemetry.sanitizeData(withToken),
        contains('Bearer [REDACTED_TOKEN]'),
      );

      // 2. Passwords and secrets
      const withPassword = '{"user": "admin", "password": "supersecret123"}';
      expect(
        telemetry.sanitizeData(withPassword),
        contains('password: "[REDACTED]"'),
      );

      // 3. API Key
      const withApiKey = 'key apiKey="AIzaSyA123456789"';
      expect(
        telemetry.sanitizeData(withApiKey),
        contains('apiKey: "[REDACTED]"'),
      );

      // 4. Google Cookies (SID / HSID)
      const withCookie = 'Cookie: SID=abc123xyz; HSID=def456; other=123';
      expect(
        telemetry.sanitizeData(withCookie),
        contains('SID=[REDACTED_COOKIE]'),
      );
      expect(
        telemetry.sanitizeData(withCookie),
        contains('HSID=[REDACTED_COOKIE]'),
      );

      // 5. Voucher code
      const withVoucher = 'Redeem attempt voucher="PERDANA7HARI"';
      expect(
        telemetry.sanitizeData(withVoucher),
        contains('voucher: "[REDACTED_CODE]"'),
      );
    });

    test('maskEmail obfuscates email addresses for privacy', () {
      expect(telemetry.maskEmail('ahmad@example.com'), 'a***d@example.com');
      expect(telemetry.maskEmail('ab@domain.com'), '*@domain.com');
      expect(telemetry.maskEmail(''), '');
      expect(telemetry.maskEmail('invalid-email'), '');
    });

    test('leaveBreadcrumb adds breadcrumbs and respects ring buffer limit', () {
      for (int i = 1; i <= 25; i++) {
        telemetry.leaveBreadcrumb('Langkah navigasi $i', category: 'navigation');
      }

      // Pastikan reporting tidak melempar exception saat dipanggil tanpa firebase
      expect(
        () async => await telemetry.reportError(
          'Simulated error',
          StackTrace.current,
          context: 'unit_test',
        ),
        returnsNormally,
      );
    });

    test('Deduplication prevents immediate duplicate error reporting', () async {
      // Panggilan pertama
      await telemetry.reportError(
        'Duplicate error message',
        StackTrace.fromString('line 1\nline 2\nline 3'),
        context: 'dedup_test',
      );

      // Panggilan kedua yang identik harus ter-deduplikasi tanpa melempar error
      expect(
        () async => await telemetry.reportError(
          'Duplicate error message',
          StackTrace.fromString('line 1\nline 2\nline 3'),
          context: 'dedup_test',
        ),
        returnsNormally,
      );
    });
  });
}
```

### TEST FILE: openturath_ai/test/widget_test.dart
```dart
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/core/arabic_utils.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/core/constants.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/core/localization.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/models/agent_model.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/models/user_model.dart';
import 'package:openturath_ai/services/research_notes_service.dart';

void main() {
  group('UserModel & ModuleEntitlement Unit Tests', () {
    test('User trial without active voucher entitlement has no access', () {
      final user = UserModel(
        uid: 'test_uid_1',
        name: 'Peneliti Turats',
        email: 'peneliti@openturath.id',
        photoUrl: '',
        plan: AppConstants.planTrial,
        questionsUsed: 4,
      );

      expect(user.isTrial, isTrue);
      expect(user.isPremium, isFalse);
      expect(user.questionsRemaining, equals(0));
      expect(user.isTrialExhausted, isFalse);
      expect(user.hasAccess, isFalse);
    });

    test('User with active voucher trial entitlement has access and questions', () {
      final user = UserModel(
        uid: 'test_uid_trial',
        name: 'Peneliti Turats',
        email: 'peneliti@openturath.id',
        photoUrl: '',
        plan: AppConstants.planTrial,
        questionsUsed: 4,
        entitlements: {
          'all_access': ModuleEntitlement(
            plan: 'trial',
            expiry: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 7)),
            status: 'active',
          ),
        },
      );

      expect(user.isTrial, isTrue);
      expect(user.hasAccess, isTrue);
      expect(user.questionsRemaining, equals(9999));
    });

    test('User trial is denied when voucher entitlement is expired', () {
      final user = UserModel(
        uid: 'test_uid_2',
        name: 'Peneliti Turats',
        email: 'peneliti@openturath.id',
        photoUrl: '',
        plan: AppConstants.planTrial,
        questionsUsed: 10,
        entitlements: {
          'all_access': ModuleEntitlement(
            plan: 'trial',
            expiry: DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(days: 1)),
            status: 'expired',
          ),
        },
      );

      expect(user.questionsRemaining, equals(0));
      expect(user.hasAccess, isFalse);
    });

    test('Modular entitlement gives exclusive access to entitled module only', () {
      final futureExpiry = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 30));
      final userWithTahawwulatOnly = UserModel(
        uid: 'test_uid_3',
        name: 'Tholib Ilmu',
        email: 'tholib@openturath.id',
        photoUrl: '',
        plan: AppConstants.planTrial,
        questionsUsed: 10, // trial habis
        entitlements: {
          'fiqh_tahawwulat': ModuleEntitlement(
            plan: AppConstants.planTholib1m,
            expiry: futureExpiry,
            status: 'active',
          ),
        },
      );

      // Harusnya bisa akses Fikih Tahawwulat dan sub-agennya
      expect(userWithTahawwulatOnly.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_tahawwulat'), isTrue);
      expect(userWithTahawwulatOnly.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_tahawwulat_muhaqqiq'), isTrue);
      expect(userWithTahawwulatOnly.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_tahawwulat_bayan'), isTrue);
      expect(userWithTahawwulatOnly.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_tahawwulat_khatib'), isTrue);

      // Tapi TIDAK BISA akses Fikih Syafi'i karena trial habis dan modul tidak dibeli
      expect(userWithTahawwulatOnly.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_syafii'), isFalse);
      expect(userWithTahawwulatOnly.hasAccessToAgent('hadits'), isFalse);
    });

    test('User with active Syafii subscription cannot access Tahawwulat even if subscriptionExpiry is active', () {
      final futureExpiry = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 30));
      final userSyafiiOnly = UserModel(
        uid: 'test_uid_syafii',
        name: 'Santri Fikih Syafii',
        email: 'syafii@openturath.id',
        photoUrl: '',
        plan: 'fiqh_syafii_1m',
        questionsUsed: 5,
        subscriptionExpiry: futureExpiry,
        entitlements: {
          'fiqh_syafii': ModuleEntitlement(
            plan: 'fiqh_syafii_1m',
            expiry: futureExpiry,
            status: 'active',
          ),
        },
      );

      // Pastikan akun aktif secara umum
      expect(userSyafiiOnly.isSubscriptionActive, isTrue);

      // Pastikan akses ke Fikih Syafi'i diizinkan
      expect(userSyafiiOnly.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_syafii'), isTrue);
      expect(userSyafiiOnly.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_syafii_muhaqqiq'), isTrue);

      // Pastikan TIDAK BISA akses Fikih Tahawwulat ataupun sub-agennya
      expect(userSyafiiOnly.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_tahawwulat'), isFalse);
      expect(userSyafiiOnly.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_tahawwulat_mukhtabir'), isFalse);
      expect(userSyafiiOnly.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_tahawwulat_bayan'), isFalse);
      expect(userSyafiiOnly.hasAccessToAgent('hadits'), isFalse);
    });

    test('Expired module entitlement correctly denies premium access', () {
      final pastExpiry = DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(days: 1));
      final userExpired = UserModel(
        uid: 'test_uid_4',
        name: 'User Expired',
        email: 'expired@openturath.id',
        photoUrl: '',
        plan: AppConstants.planTrial,
        questionsUsed: 10,
        entitlements: {
          'fiqh_tahawwulat': ModuleEntitlement(
            plan: AppConstants.planTholib1m,
            expiry: pastExpiry,
            status: 'active',
          ),
        },
      );

      expect(userExpired.isAgentSubscriptionActive('fiqh_tahawwulat'), isFalse);
      expect(userExpired.hasAccessToAgent('fiqh_tahawwulat_khatib'), isFalse);
    });
  });

  group('AgentModel Catalog Tests', () {
    test('Default catalog contains core modules with complete metadata', () {
      final agents = AgentModel.defaultAgents;
      expect(agents.isNotEmpty, isTrue);

      final tahawwulat = agents.firstWhere((a) => a.id == 'fiqh_tahawwulat');
      expect(tahawwulat.title, contains('Tahawwulat'));
      expect(tahawwulat.subAgents?.length, equals(5));
      expect(tahawwulat.referenceBooks?.isNotEmpty, isTrue);
    });
  });

  group('ResearchNote & Citation Generator Tests', () {
    test('ResearchNote formats citation correctly with book, volume, and page', () {
      final note = ResearchNote(
        id: 'note_123',
        agentId: 'fiqh_tahawwulat',
        agentTitle: 'Fiqh Tahawwulat AI',
        title: 'Konsep Sunnah Mawaqif',
        excerpt: 'Sunnah mawaqif adalah ketetapan sikap kenabian dalam menghadapi perubahan zaman.',
        bookTitle: 'Al-Bayan',
        bookVolume: '1',
        bookPage: '45',
        createdAt: DateTime.now(),
      );

      final citation = note.citationFormatted;
      expect(citation, contains('Sunnah mawaqif'));
      expect(citation, contains('OpenTurath AI (Fiqh Tahawwulat AI)'));
      expect(citation, contains('Kitab Al-Bayan Juz 1 Hal 45'));
    });
  });

  group('ArabicUtils Smart Arabic Search Tests', () {
    test('ArabicUtils.normalize strips harakat and unifies letter forms', () {
      const textWithHarakat = 'فِقْهُ التَّحَوُّلَاتِ';
      final normalized = ArabicUtils.normalize(textWithHarakat);
      expect(normalized, equals('فقه التحولات'));
    });

    test('ArabicUtils.matches matches plain query with harakat text', () {
      const sourceArabic = 'فِقْهُ التَّحَوُّلَاتِ وَسُنَّةُ الْمَوَاقِفِ';
      
      // Pencarian tanpa harakat
      expect(ArabicUtils.matches(sourceArabic, 'فقه'), isTrue);
      expect(ArabicUtils.matches(sourceArabic, 'التحولات'), isTrue);
      expect(ArabicUtils.matches(sourceArabic, 'سنة'), isTrue);
      expect(ArabicUtils.matches(sourceArabic, 'المواقف'), isTrue);

      // Pencarian kata yang tidak ada
      expect(ArabicUtils.matches(sourceArabic, 'نحو'), isFalse);
    });

    test('ArabicUtils.matches supports Latin search in bilingual metadata', () {
      const sourceLatin = 'Fiqh Tahawwulat & Al-Manhaji';
      expect(ArabicUtils.matches(sourceLatin, 'tahawwulat'), isTrue);
      expect(ArabicUtils.matches(sourceLatin, 'manhaji'), isTrue);
      expect(ArabicUtils.matches(sourceLatin, 'hadits'), isFalse);
    });
  });

  group('Localization & AppConfig Tests', () {
    test('Localization dictionary returns valid strings for all supported languages', () {
      expect(Loc.tr('app_name'), equals('OpenTurath AI'));
      expect(Loc.tr('choose_plan'), isNotEmpty);
      expect(Loc.tr('save'), isNotEmpty);
    });
  });
}
```
